OIC Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: OIC Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $80,000–$110,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced OIC Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration scenarios that connect Oracle Cloud Applications, on-premises Oracle systems, and third-party platforms. In this role you will own the full integration lifecycle, from analysis and design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on experience with OIC integrations, processes, and visual builder applications, and will combine that with a clear understanding of integration patterns, API management, and Oracle Cloud Applications data models.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of integration experience, with strong hands-on time in Oracle Integration Cloud.
  • Solid experience with Oracle Cloud Applications (ERP, HCM, or CX) data models and APIs.
  • Experience with REST and SOAP web service development.
  • Working knowledge of Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) and Process Cloud Service.
  • Familiarity with API management concepts and Oracle API Platform.
  • Strong scripting skills (Groovy, JavaScript) and SQL.
  • Experience with security standards (OAuth2, SAML, mTLS).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Prior experience migrating from Oracle SOA Suite to OIC is a strong plus.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Oracle Cloud Platform Application Integration certification.
  • Experience with Oracle Autonomous Database integration.
  • Familiarity with event-driven integration on OCI.
  • Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD patterns for OIC content.
  • Working knowledge of related platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP CPI).
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to

Job Title:Payroll Transformation Specialist
Company:Solen Software Group
Location:US, Remote or on-site
Employment Type :Full-time

About Solen Software Group

Solen Software Group is an investment and operating company that acquires and operates proven software businesses with significant growth potential across a variety of vertical markets, enabling each to become a market leader in its niche. Solen's portfolio spans Human Resource Technology, Fleet Telematics, Asset Management, E-Health, Document Management, and other innovative software solutions. Solen is backed by a group of advisors and investors who have built software businesses of material scale (10–100M in ARR) and have advised many more. We are at the beginning of a decades-long journey, and every decision we make reflects that long time horizon.

About the Role

We are looking for a Payroll Transformation Specialist to support payroll operations, integrations, and process improvement across Solen and its portfolio companies. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving payroll challenges, working with data, and building reliable processes. You do not need to be an expert in every country. What matters is that you are curious, organized, and happy to figure out the answers.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Operations and Integration

  • Support payroll integration for newly acquired companies.
  • Coordinate payroll implementations, provider transitions, testing, and go-live activities.
  • Collect, validate, and reconcile employee and payroll data.
  • Review payroll inputs and outputs for accuracy and completeness.
  • Support new hires, terminations, compensation changes, deductions, taxes, and one-time payments.
  • Help resolve payroll issues accurately and on time.

Compliance and Controls

  • Maintain payroll calendars, checklists, approvals, reconciliations, and audit-ready records.
  • Support payroll tax registrations, notices, statutory reporting, and year-end activities.
  • Reconcile payroll deductions with benefits and HR system records.
  • Partner with Finance, HR, portfolio leaders, EORs, and local payroll providers.
  • Identify and escalate compliance or employee-impacting risks promptly.

Systems and Process Improvement

  • Document payroll processes and develop standard procedures, templates, and controls.
  • Support payroll system configuration, testing, data cleanup, and reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and automate manual work.
  • Track implementation milestones, deadlines, risks, and outstanding decisions.
  • Help standardize payroll practices while accounting for local requirements.

Key Requirements:

  • 2-5 years of experience in payroll administration, implementation, HR operations, accounting support, or a related area.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience supporting acquisitions, payroll conversions, or a global workforce.
  • Excellent organization, analytical ability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to investigate discrepancies and clearly communicate findings.
  • Comfort working across multiple companies, countries, currencies, and time zones.
  • Sound judgment when handling confidential payroll information.
  • A practical, responsive, and service-minded approach.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • Exposure to payroll in Brazil, Portugal, Canada, the UK, or the United States.
  • Experience with Deel, Rippling, Multiplier, Paylocity, Paychex, TriNet, or similar platforms.
  • Payroll certification or relevant coursework.

Solen-isms (How We Operate)

  • Ownership Mindset: We own the mission. We don't wait to be told. We lead, fix, and build as if it were ours. When problems arise, we run toward them, not away.
  • Benchmark to Best: We seek out excellence. We measure ourselves against the best and adapt quickly, always looking for the edge that moves us forward.
  • Openly Self-Critical: Leaders go first: they surface their misses early, ask for direct feedback, and turn “game film” into better decisions and better systems.
  • Disagree & Commit: Leaders disagree openly and constructively, regardless of title or tenure, because truth is how we avoid bureaucracy and benchmark to best.
  • Figureitoutiveness: Embracing challenges, fostering growth, and taking initiative, leaders thrive on hard work and high failure tolerance.
  • Mutual Elevation: Committed to growth, elevating teams, developing future leaders, and removing barriers to mastery and joy.
  • Learn-it-alls: Learn-it-alls, not know-it-alls, embracing failure as part of growth and progress.
  • Pioneering: Pioneering driven by opportunity, using first principles thinking and unbound by tradition or rules.
  • Will to Win: Leaders relentlessly pursue potential, reject mediocrity, and get what they tolerate.
  • Dialectical: We learn through conversation. We ask, listen, question, and evolve — valuing disagreement as a tool for alignment and deeper understanding.
  • Frugality: Achieving more with less, focusing on quality, long-term value, and company-wide responsibility.
  • Candor: We communicate with integrity, transparency, and respect in all conversations.
  • Kaizen: Kaizen is continuous improvement as a way of life. Leaders make hundreds of small upgrades that compound, turning lessons into standards and standards into durable systems.

Recruitment Disclaimer
Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.
We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

raw.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Garantir a qualidade da entrega do produto da melhor maneira possível e ao mesmo tempo desenvolver, manter e evoluir os nossos processos de Qualidade com foco em Testes de APIs e microserviços.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Implantar e disseminar a cultura de qualidade para o time e dentro de projetos correlacionados.
  • Criar um relacionamento de parceria junto a área de desenvolvimento para que haja alinhamento para a criação e evolução do projeto / produto.
  • Executar os testes funcionais manuais e automatizados, com objetivo de garantir a qualidade da entrega (código / produto / processo). Avaliar e mitigar possíveis bugs (código / produto / produção) que possam aparecer durante o desenvolvimento do projeto / produto.
  • Compreender a demanda e regras de negócio para garantir a qualidade da entrega e alinhamento entre projetos /produtos. Participar ativamente dos ritos ágeis do time.
  • Executar testes exploratórios e integrados, a partir dos requisitos definidos pelo cliente (interno / externo).
  • Compreender design e padrões de API para executar os testes atendendo às diversas demandas do projeto / produto.
  • Realizar reuniões junto ao cliente para alinhamento de demandas.
  • Identificar novas ferramentas e inovações que sejam adequadas para o projeto / produto, considerando as particularidades do contexto em que estiver inserido.
  • Criar e aprimorar documentos que facilitem a utilização do produto para o usuário a partir de orientações recebidas dos líderes e arquitetos.
  • Realizar o levantamento de cenários de testes, identificando fluxos básicos e alternativos.
  • Preparar massa de dados para execução de cenários de testes.
  • Colaborar na coleta de dados para criação de métricas e gerar estimativas para entregar ao cliente.
  • Preparar o ambiente de teste para iniciar os testes seguindo as demandas.
  • Aplicar os conceitos de testes adequados para garantir a qualidade da entrega.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Experiência em ferramentas de testes android como: Appium, Robot Framework, Roboeletric, JUnit, Mockk, Espresso e UI Automator;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de testes para backend como: Postman e Newman;
  • Ferramentas utilizadas pela companhia: Jira, Git, Zephyr Scale, RabbitMQ e Openshift;
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD como: Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines ou Gitlab;
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com testes em Microserviços e filas de processamentos como o RabbitMQ;
  • Experiência em versionamento com Git;
  • Experiência em banco de dados (SQL, NoSQL);
  • Ter atuado em times ágeis;
  • Ter visão de todo o ciclo de entrega da solução e propor melhorias;
  • Conhecimentos em APIs RESTful e GraphQL;
  • Forte senso de análise crítica e validação de problemas na aplicação e consulta de logs para extração e abertura de bugs para equipe de desenvolvimento.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência com automação de testes, em alguma linguagem de programação, como: Javascript, Java ou NodeJS;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de automação de testes como: Cucumber, JUnit, Postman/Newman, REST Assured, JMeter.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)
*Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018

raw.description:
Working Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8am – 5pm Mountain Standard Time

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Salary: 2,000 - 2,500 USD

Employer: AI company located in Phoenix, Arizona

The Role

This is a new kind of engineering role. You won't be a code monkey wired into a backlog. You'll own features end-to-end using Claude Code and other coding agents: design, implementation, testing, shipping. You direct the AI, you read every line it produces, and you ship the finished thing.

You'll work across the platform: Threo (the client workspace), Wingtip (agentic execution from plain English requests), Pylon (agent creation and runtime), and Canopy (the control plane for every client tenant).

Our stack spans .NET/C# and FastAPI (Python) on the backend, React on the frontend, and PostgreSQL for data. You don't need to know it all on day one — you need to ramp fast with coding agents and ship in stacks you haven't touched before. We hire for taste and velocity.

What You'll Do

  • Take a problem from rough idea to shipped feature: design, build, test, deploy, working from specs and repo-level agent instructions you and your agents both use. No handoffs for "the real implementation."
  • Read every line the AI produces. You're accountable for what ships, not the model.
  • Operate two, three, or more AI agents at once across separate work streams (new features, bug fixes, refactors), keeping each in its own sandbox or work tree and shipping from all of them the same day without losing state or scope.
  • Ship services in .NET 10 LTS / C# (ASP.NET Core, Minimal APIs, background workers).
  • Build and extend Python services using FastAPI for our agent execution engine and adjacent tooling.
  • Design and evolve data models in PostgreSQL: schema, migrations, indexes, query performance.
  • Build React 19 interfaces with the stable React Compiler — admin consoles, data grids, forms, and chat UIs.
  • Implement streaming chat and live updates, and integrate with LLM providers via tool calling and MCP servers, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.
  • Write tests, write docs, close the loop, and debug across services and stacks — the AI helps, but it doesn't excuse you from understanding the system. The bar is "that's done," not "the happy path works."
  • Ship via Docker and GitHub Actions to our cloud infrastructure.

What We're Looking For

We hire on AI fluency, judgment, and velocity, not years of experience. If you live in Claude Code (or Cursor, or Codex) and ship real software with it, we want to talk.

Must Have

  • Daily, fluent use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar). We care that you can direct an agent through a non-trivial feature without losing the plot — not which tool you use — and that your first instinct is to design with AI in the loop.
  • Parallel agent management. You can run multiple agents at once across separate work streams (features, bug fixes, refactors) and deliver shipped work from each.
  • Solid programming fundamentals. You can read and reason about code in at least one of: C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Python. You understand HTTP APIs, relational databases, and basic async patterns. You can debug what you didn't write.
  • Product sense. You can look at a half-formed requirement, ask the right three questions, then ship something the user actually wants.
  • Ownership and clear async communication. When you pick up a feature, you finish it: tests, docs, no dangling threads, no partial solves left for someone else.
  • Quality checks on AI output. You ship the full loop — traces, trajectory-level evals, and guardrails against prompt injection — and can show a non-deterministic feature is safe in front of paying customers.

Nice to Have

  • Streaming systems (WebSockets, SignalR, or similar).
  • LLM integration work: tool calling and MCP servers, streaming, and retrieval or context engineering.
  • LLM cost and latency optimization: caching, model routing, token budgets.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture.
  • Familiarity with MSP/PSA ecosystems (ConnectWise, Autotask, Datto RMM, etc.).

raw.description:
Position Summary

Sr. Transmission Line Engineer – Texas, Louisiana, Arkansas, or Florida - Remote

At NV5, we fully understand the United States aging electrical grid faces significant challenges in meeting the increasing demand for power delivery. Moreover, navigating through permitting requirements can often stall the design and implementation of modern transmission and distribution assets.

By harnessing our expertise and providing cutting-edge solutions, NV5 steps in as a leader, to enhance distribution system capacity, fortify against fire and storm risks, and elevate the reliability of electrical service for utility customers. Leveraging proprietary design methodologies and state-of-the-art modeling software, we tackle complex site-specific obstacles head-on, reducing construction timelines and costs associated with electrical distribution and transmission improvements.

We have an opportunity for a talented & ambitious Sr. Engineer with Overhead (OH) Transmission Line experience to join us as our new Sr.Transmission Line Engineer.

In this role, you will play a pivotal role in establishing relationships that go beyond the realm of the project at hand. The right individual will be the client technical lead to help build relationships and grow our engineering portfolio throughout Texas and the Southeast of the US.

You will work on challenging assignments that include investigating, troubleshooting, and solving a wide variety of transmission line and related civil engineering problems involving overhead power lines and substations.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the responsible engineer and client point of contact for power delivery projects.
  • Increase the volume of overhead line work with existing clients.
  • Assist in marketing, promotion and business development efforts to add new regional clients.
  • Prepare, review, and P.E. seal technical calculation reports and construction documents meeting client and NV5 requirements.
  • Assist in the routing and design of overhead transmission lines using industry-standard tools.
  • Support the preparation of engineering drawings, specifications, bill of materials and technical documentation.
  • Participate in field visits to collect data and support construction activities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure project success.
  • Contribute to project planning, cost estimation and proposal preparation.
  • Maintain organized records of project decisions and communications.
  • Structure analysis and foundation design.
  • Developing design criteria and specifications.
  • Develop your career via peer-learning through sharing knowledge with other experienced engineers and train and mentor junior staff.
  • Manage multiple projects and provide engineering QA/QC
  • Travel to client sites as needed.
  • Mentor junior staff.

Requirements

We are seeking the following experience:

  • B.S. degree in Civil, Structural, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering from an ABET-accredited program.
  • 10+ of progressive experience within overhead transmission line projects along with QA/QC is desired.
  • Expertise with Power Line Systems software (PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE), MFAD and L-Pile is required.
  • Experience with PLS-TOWER is a plus.
  • Professional Engineering (P.E.) registration.

Compensation & Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $125,000 - $165,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. Additional compensation may include restricted stock units, performance-based bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package covering medical, dental, PTO, 401(k), unlimited FTO (Flexible Time Off) and professional development opportunities.

#INDHP

Benefits

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

  • Competitive Salary
  • Medical, dental, and supplemental insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Company paid Life & AD&D
  • Company paid Disability
  • 401K Plan
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Time Off

Company Overview

NV5 delivers technology-enabled engineering, consulting, and geospatial solutions that help clients plan, design, and optimize infrastructure, buildings, utilities, and environmental systems. We bring together technical expertise, data, and innovative thinking to create resilient, high-performance assets. As part of TiC Solutions, alongside Acuren, we share a purpose: to shape and strengthen the physical world.

Our work starts with our people. We invest in their growth and never compromise on safety. We work as one team across disciplines and geographies, bringing diverse perspectives and a shared purpose to complex challenges.

At NV5, we take pride in high-quality work that creates lasting value for our clients. We challenge the status quo, continuously improve, and turn insight into smarter designs, plans, and solutions. Join us to contribute your expertise and collaborate with our teams to help shape the infrastructure and systems the world relies on.

raw.description:
Do you notice when the kerning is off on a heading before you've read a word of the copy?

Do you look at a clean, functional interface and immediately see ten ways to make it feel more premium?

Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining grooming for the modern consumer. We've built one of the strongest paid acquisition engines in DTC. Now we're raising the visual and experiential quality of our digital product to match the brand we've built.

We're looking for a Senior UX/UI Designer with a strong emphasis on visual design excellence. We need someone who takes a good interface and makes it exceptional: someone who obsesses over typography, spacing, layout, colour, consistency, and the finer details that elevate a design from functional to memorable. UX knowledge and an understanding of user journeys are important. Visual design craftsmanship is where you must truly excel.

This role owns the Freebird design system, the UI across our digital surfaces, and the visual quality bar the whole team builds toward. You'll work closely with our Senior Director of Design and collaborate with product and engineering to ship work that looks and feels as good as it performs.

You'll report to the Senior Director of Design. This role is 100% remote. We require meaningful overlap with US working hours.

If you obsess over the details that make digital products feel premium, and you've been waiting for a seat where that craft is genuinely valued, this role is for you.

What You'll Own

Set the Visual Design Standard

This is the heart of the role.

  • Create beautiful, polished, premium digital experiences that represent Freebird at its best across every touchpoint.
  • Take good interfaces and make them exceptional through meticulous attention to typography, layout, colour, spacing, and visual detail.
  • Apply a strong visual point of view that pushes design beyond execution and into craft.
  • Maintain a consistently high quality bar across web and app surfaces without needing to be managed on the basics.
  • Set the visual standard that the rest of the design team builds toward.

Build and Maintain the Freebird Design System

The design system is the foundation that holds the visual standard across everything.

  • Own the component library, design tokens, and pattern documentation in Figma.
  • Maintain version control and governance so the system grows predictably and consistently.
  • Act as the consistency gatekeeper: reviewing team output, flagging deviations, and evolving the system as the product expands.
  • Collaborate with engineers on implementation so that what's designed is what ships.
  • Create clear specifications that enable smooth, low-back-and-forth implementation.

Lead UX Design with Strong Visual Judgment

  • Design responsive, accessible experiences across desktop and mobile, led by strong visual instinct.
  • Create user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes that are both functionally sound and visually sharp.
  • Apply UX knowledge to make well-structured, user-centered design decisions independently.
  • Validate and improve designs using product data and customer feedback after launch.

Ship Production-Ready UI at Senior Velocity

  • Take stakeholder briefs to polished, production-ready designs within sprint cadence.
  • Deliver complete handoffs to engineering: specs, interaction notes, edge-case coverage.
  • Contribute to sprint planning and grooming by estimating accurately and delivering on commitments.
  • Support design quality reviews so that what ships matches what was designed.

Contribute to the Design Culture

  • Bring a strong visual point of view to critiques and team discussions.
  • Support junior designers and help establish shared ways of working as the function grows.
  • Present design decisions clearly and respond constructively to feedback at all levels, including from a CEO with strong design opinions.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6-12 months:

  • Freebird's digital surfaces look and feel noticeably more premium than when you joined.
  • A documented, scalable design system is used consistently across all digital touchpoints.
  • Design handoffs are clean, complete, and require minimal clarification from engineering.
  • You are the person the team goes to when the visual quality of something isn't right.
  • Junior designers have a clear visual standard to work toward and structured feedback to guide them.

Requirements

We're looking for an exceptional UI/UX designer with a strong emphasis on visual design. Outstanding craft is the requirement. Strong UX knowledge is the complement.

  • 5+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a track record of delivering high-quality digital products end-to-end.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates exceptional visual design quality across real digital products. We want to see your eye, your craft, and your attention to detail, not just your process.
  • Proven experience building, maintaining, or significantly contributing to a design system used in a live product.
  • Strong skills in visual design: typography, layout, colour, hierarchy, spacing, and the ability to create polished, premium interfaces.
  • Solid UX knowledge: user journeys, information architecture, wireframes, and prototyping. Enough to make sound, independent design decisions.
  • Solid understanding of accessibility principles and inclusive design (WCAG familiarity required).
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma.
  • Ability to work autonomously, communicate blockers proactively, and maintain momentum without waiting for perfect processes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for DTC ecommerce, subscription products, or consumer digital experiences.
  • Familiarity with Shopify or headless commerce environments.
  • CRO awareness or interest in conversion-focused design (our team generates the ideas, you execute).
  • Understanding of HTML and CSS constraints.
  • Experience mentoring designers or running design critique sessions.

Benefits

  • Visual quality is taken seriously here. Your craft will be valued, not compromised.
  • Your work ships. Design decisions are measured against real outcomes, not debated indefinitely.
  • No politics, just execution. Join a fast-moving, high-ownership, results-driven culture.
  • Make your mark by helping scale a 9-figure DTC brand on the verge of global breakout.
  • Kind, people-focused team that communicates openly, collaborates well, and supports one another.
  • Remote-first and flexible. Work from anywhere with autonomy and trust.
  • Unlimited PTO. Recharge when you need to, without counting days.

Manager, People Operations, Systems & Analytics-Full Remote

Our Organization

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public media.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information, visit www.cdpcommunity.org

Job Summary:

This is a rare opportunity to join CDP at a pivotal moment of rapid growth and evolution—and to have a meaningful seat at the table in shaping what comes next. As Manager, People Operations, Systems & Analytics, you will help build the People infrastructure behind an extraordinarily active, mission-driven organization, translating strategy into scalable systems, trusted insights, and exceptional employee experiences. You will partner across the business to strengthen and advance a robust inclusion and culture strategy, an evolving talent strategy, and the operational capabilities needed to prepare CDP for the future. Serving as the technical and analytical backbone of the People function, you will lead critical compensation, benefits, compliance, systems, reporting, and automation work while influencing decisions that directly support company strategy, organizational effectiveness, and sustainable growth. The ideal candidate combines strong HR expertise with hands-on systems administration, advanced analytics, rigorous attention to detail, and the curiosity to use AI and automation to transform how work gets done.

The role will be a contract position for a year with the potential to convert to perm.

How you’ll contribute:

  • Compensation cycles: Administer annual merit, compensation, and bonus cycles, including system configuration, data preparation, validation, audit controls, reporting, and coordination with People and Finance partners.
  • Salary structures: Maintain salary grades, compensation structures, and related system data; produce analysis that supports compensation decisions and consistent program administration.
  • HR systems: Serve as a primary technical administrator for HRIS and connected People platforms, including configuration, user access, business rules, data imports, troubleshooting, vendor coordination, and ongoing platform optimization.
  • Workforce insights: Develop recurring and ad hoc workforce reporting, dashboards, and executive-ready insights, including Board reporting, workforce metrics, engagement and pulse survey results, and inclusion and culture measures.
  • Compliance and audits: Manage required People-related reporting and compliance processes, including ACA, EEO-1, Form 5500, and other applicable federal and state requirements; support internal and external audits.
  • Open Enrollment: Coordinate the operational and technical components of annual Open Enrollment, including system setup, testing, employee data validation, enrollment reporting, and reconciliation with vendors and payroll.
  • Automation and self-service: Design and implement workflow automation, AI-enabled tools, and employee and manager self-service solutions that improve accuracy, reduce manual effort, and strengthen the employee experience.
  • Scalable People Operations: Lead People Operations projects and maintain process maps, standard operating procedures, data definitions, controls, and end-user documentation to support consistent and scalable practices.

Experience/Skills

Five or more years of progressive experience in People Operations, HRIS, compensation, benefits, workforce analytics, or a related technical HR discipline, including experience independently managing complex cycles or projects.

Hands-on experience administering an HRIS or People platform such as ADP Workforce Now, ChartHop, or a comparable system, including configuration, data management, security, reporting, testing, and issue resolution.

Strong technical reporting and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capability; experience with leveraging Microsoft Co-pilot to build dashboards and metrics.

Working knowledge of compensation administration, including merit and bonus cycles, salary grades, pay structures, data validation, and compensation reporting.

Experience supporting benefits administration and Open Enrollment, with familiarity with ACA, EEO-1, Form 5500, audit, and other HR compliance requirements.

Demonstrated ability to maintain data integrity, establish controls, reconcile information across systems, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Experience improving workflows through automation, AI-enabled tools, integrations, or low-code solutions; curiosity and sound judgment regarding responsible use of employee data and technology.

Strong project management, documentation, vendor management, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and handle sensitive information with discretion.

Educational Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience preferred. Relevant HR, compensation, benefits, analytics, project management, or HR technology credentials are a plus.

Job Description

Manager, Platform Integrations & Engineering


The opportunity

The Manager, Platform Integrations & Engineering leads a global team that designs, builds, and supports secure, scalable integrations for CRG Digital platforms and clinical research capabilities. You will set engineering standards across enterprise applications, data platforms, vendor ecosystems, and cloud technologies, while guiding the shift from bespoke development to reusable, configurable, and increasingly automated solutions.


What you’ll do

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a global team of integration and platform engineers responsible for development and production support; set clear expectations for quality, ownership, delivery, and operational excellence.
  • Provide technical oversight across SQL, Python, Talend, MuleSoft, Oracle SOA, Tidal, Snowflake, and Databricks. Partner with Platform Architecture and solution architects to turn enterprise architecture direction into repeatable engineering patterns.
  • Set and enforce standards for API, file-based, database, event-driven, batch, and cloud integrations, including SOPs, reusable patterns, naming and coding conventions, technical documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Promote configuration and reuse first, with clear criteria for when teams should configure, reuse, extend, custom-build, retain, modernize, consolidate, or replace a solution. Minimize bespoke development and modernize legacy integrations toward API-first and cloud-native patterns.
  • Ensure integrations meet requirements for scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, performance, and operational support. Support enterprise applications, clinical and vendor platforms, APIs, cloud data platforms, external partners, and data movement into and across Snowflake, Databricks, and cloud object storage.
  • Advance CI/CD and DevOps maturity. Establish source control, branching, pull requests, peer reviews, release management, and automated testing; build reusable unit and regression testing frameworks for standard integration patterns.
  • Automate build validation, code quality, static analysis, vulnerability and secrets scanning, deployment gates, and release validation. Use AI-assisted development and testing where appropriate for code, documentation, test cases, troubleshooting, and repeatable work, with governance and human oversight
  • Ensure practices comply with applicable SDLC, change-control, validation, cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirements. Maintain segregation of duties, traceability, deployment approval, and production access controls.
  • Keep integration assets documented with clear ownership, dependencies, support procedures, and lifecycle plans. Partner with Run-the-Engine and support teams on escalation paths, knowledge transfer, support documentation, and engineering ownership.
  • Keep production integration monitored, observable, supportable, and resilient. Establish proactive logging, alerting, dependency management, and automated recovery where feasible; drive root-cause analysis and permanent fixes for recurring failures.
  • Track availability, failures, incident volume, mean time to detect and resolve, deployment quality, defect leakage, technical debt, SLA performance, development cycle time, quality, automation, productivity, integration health, capacity, and operational risk.
  • Balance project delivery, modernization, technical debt, production support, and strategic priorities; allocate resources accordingly. Partner with Product, Architecture, Data, Quality, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, business stakeholders, and manage vendor or contractor resources to the same standards.

What you will bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Comparable to 8+ years of progressive technology or integration engineering experience, including significant experience leading technical engineering teams.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise integrations in complex production environments, including production-critical services and root-cause analysis and remediation.
  • Demonstrated technical experience with several of the following: Talend; MuleSoft / Anypoint Platform; Oracle SOA; SQL; Python; Snowflake; Databricks; and Tidal or comparable enterprise scheduling/orchestration technology.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, web services, file-based and database integrations, batch processing, middleware, enterprise integration patterns, and cloud data and integration architectures.
  • Experience with Git-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code review, and modern DevOps practices.

Preferred experience

  • Clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or another highly regulated industry.
  • GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), regulated SDLC, change-control, and auditability requirements.
  • Modernizing legacy integration estates and moving teams toward API-first, reusable, cloud-native patterns.
  • Automated software-quality and security controls in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Data integration for enterprise data platforms and lakehouse architectures, including Snowflake, Databricks, and cloud object storage.
  • AI-assisted engineering in a controlled enterprise development environment.

How you lead

You bring technical credibility to design reviews and engineering decisions; establish disciplined standards; take ownership through root cause and lasting resolution; balance delivery with long-term architecture and sustainability; reduce manual effort, technical debt, duplication, and operational overhead; develop engineers into technical leaders; and work effectively across architecture, data, product, quality, cybersecurity, and business teams.


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, we are committed to fostering a healthy and harmonious workplace for our employees. We understand the importance of creating an environment that allows individuals to excel. Please see below for the required qualifications for this position, which also includes the possibility of equivalent experience:

  • Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.
  • Able to work upright and stationary for typical working hours.
  • Ability to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency.
  • Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.
  • May require as-needed travel (0-20%).

Location: Remote US. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

*Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

*Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.


The annual salary range estimated for this position in North Carolina is $105,000 - $150,000. This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy.

Networks, Integration & Automation (NIA)

Grid Modernization: Now, more than ever, reliable, and secure communication for grid operations is essential. We work with electric utilities to expand their capabilities with the latest technologies for remote monitoring, automation, and control to improve their operational efficiency.

Networks: We help our clients build redundant, long-haul, high-capacity private data networks via a variety of technologies that are used for both business/IT needs as well as the day-to-day operational needs that keep the lights on.

Renewable Energy: With the expansion of renewable energy technologies, our team works to connect these assets to electric grid infrastructure to provide critical communications for the local utility and system operator in areas such as offshore wind, solar photovoltaic (PV), hydroelectric power, and battery storage.

Rural Broadband: As engineers, we have a social responsibility to support our communities. Our NIA team works to help our clients provide high-speed internet access to rural communities to advance educational and economic opportunities and help close the digital divide.

Private LTE: We are supporting the development of entirely private carrier-grade wireless networks for electric utilities, unlocking new capabilities to monitor and manage the grid and ultimately better serve customers. Private LTE is one application of many within our wireless portfolio.

Fiber: Fiber optic infrastructure is one of the fastest ways that utilities transmit high-bandwidth data, and our team is helping to expand that infrastructure from their core networks all the way to customer homes.

Electric Vehicles: We work with industry leaders and electric utilities to help our customers transition to beneficial and cost-effective transportation electrification.

  • Manage and oversee all aspects of multi-discipline engineering projects from concept to completion including overall safety, siting, environmental, permitting, planning, estimating, engineering, right-of-way acquisition, project controls, bid phase services, procurement, constructability reviews, material management, and closeout.
  • Develop and monitor project schedules, manage scope, and control project costs.

raw.description:
About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect, you are the technical owner of our most complex enterprise deals. You will lead the technical sale from first discovery call through architecture review, security sign-off, proof-of-concept and close, working side by side with Account Executives on strategic accounts.

Our buyers are CISOs, CIOs, IT architects and security and compliance leaders at large, regulated organizations. They are replacing or reducing VDI, locking down contractor and BYOD access, and answering to auditors. You will earn their trust by designing a solution that fits their identity, endpoint, network and compliance stack, and by proving it works in their environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You will shape how we run technical evaluations, set the standard for demos and POCs, and bring field insight to Product that changes the roadmap. You are part engineer, part consultant and part storyteller, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in a room of executives.

What You'll Do

  • Lead enterprise technical discovery. Partner with Account Executives to map each customer's identity, endpoint, VDI, network and data-protection environment, and the business and compliance drivers behind the project.
  • Architect solutions for complex environments. Design deployments that integrate with Microsoft 365/Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, Google Workspace, existing VDI, VPN and ZTNA, and endpoint and DLP tooling, and document the reference architecture for the customer's review.
  • Own proofs-of-concept and technical evaluations. Define success criteria with the customer up front, run the POC end to end, and turn the results into a clear business case.
  • Run security reviews. Lead security questionnaires, RFP and RFI technical responses, architecture reviews and compliance mapping with customer security, risk and legal teams.
  • Present at every level. Deliver deep technical sessions for engineers and architects, and concise value-led narratives for CISOs, CIOs and other executive sponsors.
  • Build the technical business case. Quantify value against incumbent approaches such as VDI, VPN and managed devices (cost, user experience, risk reduction) alongside the Account Executive.
  • Handle competition. Stay current on the competitive landscape and industry trends, and position Venn against VDI, DaaS, VPN, browser isolation and MDM-based approaches in secure BYOD enablement.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Build demo environments, POC playbooks, battlecards and reusable solution content, and mentor junior Sales Engineers.
  • Close the loop with Product. Bring structured customer and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering so it informs the roadmap, and make sure customers feel supported from evaluation through handoff to Customer Success.
  • Represent Venn externally. Speak as a subject matter expert at webinars, conferences and industry events to build awareness and thought leadership.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in a technical pre-sales role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect or similar) at a SaaS or security company, with at least 5 years selling to large enterprise and regulated customers.
  • A track record of leading the technical side of six- and seven-figure deals with multiple stakeholders, long cycles and formal security review.
  • Experience running structured POCs with defined success criteria that convert to closed-won.
  • Strong expertise in end-user computing, Windows environments and virtual desktop infrastructure (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or similar), including the limits that drive customers to look for alternatives.
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access: Microsoft Entra ID/Microsoft 365, Okta and Google Workspace, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, conditional access and MFA.
  • Solid grounding in networking and secure access: VPN, ZTNA, proxies, DNS and firewalls, and secure browsing.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (EDR/XDR, MDM/UEM), DLP and data-protection controls, and how they behave on unmanaged and contractor devices.
  • Fluency in compliance and regulatory frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SEC, FINRA and SOC 2, and in how to map product controls to audit requirements.
  • Comfort scripting and working with APIs (PowerShell, Python or similar) to build demos, automate POCs and troubleshoot in customer environments.
  • Credibility with technical and executive audiences alike: you can whiteboard an architecture with an engineer in the morning and defend the business case to a CISO in the afternoon.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn technical depth into clear, customer-focused value.
  • A consultative approach to discovery: you uncover the real problem, not just the stated requirements.
  • Strong ownership and judgment: you prioritize across several deals, know when to bring in Product or Engineering, and make Account Executives better.
  • Comfortable traveling to customer sites and events (adjust percentage to your needs).

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience at a growth-stage company, where you helped build the pre-sales function, playbooks or POC process.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft (SC-300, AZ-500, MD-102), Okta, or Citrix/VMware credentials.
  • Prior experience selling into financial services, healthcare or other regulated industries.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

  • Competitive compensation and commission opportunities
  • Equity at Venn
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
  • Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

Soft Skills Required

raw.excerpt: About Venn Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces.
raw.description:
About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Sales Engineer/Solutions Architect, you are the technical owner of our most complex enterprise deals. You will lead the technical sale from first discovery call through architecture review, security sign-off, proof-of-concept and close, working side by side with Account Executives on strategic accounts.

Our buyers are CISOs, CIOs, IT architects and security and compliance leaders at large, regulated organizations. They are replacing or reducing VDI, locking down contractor and BYOD access, and answering to auditors. You will earn their trust by designing a solution that fits their identity, endpoint, network and compliance stack, and by proving it works in their environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You will shape how we run technical evaluations, set the standard for demos and POCs, and bring field insight to Product that changes the roadmap. You are part engineer, part consultant and part storyteller, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in a room of executives.

What You'll Do

  • Lead enterprise technical discovery. Partner with Account Executives to map each customer's identity, endpoint, VDI, network and data-protection environment, and the business and compliance drivers behind the project.
  • Architect solutions for complex environments. Design deployments that integrate with Microsoft 365/Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, Google Workspace, existing VDI, VPN and ZTNA, and endpoint and DLP tooling, and document the reference architecture for the customer's review.
  • Own proofs-of-concept and technical evaluations. Define success criteria with the customer up front, run the POC end to end, and turn the results into a clear business case.
  • Run security reviews. Lead security questionnaires, RFP and RFI technical responses, architecture reviews and compliance mapping with customer security, risk and legal teams.
  • Present at every level. Deliver deep technical sessions for engineers and architects, and concise value-led narratives for CISOs, CIOs and other executive sponsors.
  • Build the technical business case. Quantify value against incumbent approaches such as VDI, VPN and managed devices (cost, user experience, risk reduction) alongside the Account Executive.
  • Handle competition. Stay current on the competitive landscape and industry trends, and position Venn against VDI, DaaS, VPN, browser isolation and MDM-based approaches in secure BYOD enablement.
  • Raise the bar for the team. Build demo environments, POC playbooks, battlecards and reusable solution content, and mentor junior Sales Engineers.
  • Close the loop with Product. Bring structured customer and competitive feedback to Product and Engineering so it informs the roadmap, and make sure customers feel supported from evaluation through handoff to Customer Success.
  • Represent Venn externally. Speak as a subject matter expert at webinars, conferences and industry events to build awareness and thought leadership.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in a technical pre-sales role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect or similar) at a SaaS or security company, with at least 5 years selling to large enterprise and regulated customers.
  • A track record of leading the technical side of six- and seven-figure deals with multiple stakeholders, long cycles and formal security review.
  • Experience running structured POCs with defined success criteria that convert to closed-won.
  • Strong expertise in end-user computing, Windows environments and virtual desktop infrastructure (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or similar), including the limits that drive customers to look for alternatives.
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access: Microsoft Entra ID/Microsoft 365, Okta and Google Workspace, including SSO, SAML/OIDC, conditional access and MFA.
  • Solid grounding in networking and secure access: VPN, ZTNA, proxies, DNS and firewalls, and secure browsing.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (EDR/XDR, MDM/UEM), DLP and data-protection controls, and how they behave on unmanaged and contractor devices.
  • Fluency in compliance and regulatory frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SEC, FINRA and SOC 2, and in how to map product controls to audit requirements.
  • Comfort scripting and working with APIs (PowerShell, Python or similar) to build demos, automate POCs and troubleshoot in customer environments.
  • Credibility with technical and executive audiences alike: you can whiteboard an architecture with an engineer in the morning and defend the business case to a CISO in the afternoon.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to turn technical depth into clear, customer-focused value.
  • A consultative approach to discovery: you uncover the real problem, not just the stated requirements.
  • Strong ownership and judgment: you prioritize across several deals, know when to bring in Product or Engineering, and make Account Executives better.
  • Comfortable traveling to customer sites and events (adjust percentage to your needs).

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience at a growth-stage company, where you helped build the pre-sales function, playbooks or POC process.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft (SC-300, AZ-500, MD-102), Okta, or Citrix/VMware credentials.
  • Prior experience selling into financial services, healthcare or other regulated industries.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

  • Competitive compensation and commission opportunities
  • Equity at Venn
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
  • Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

The Principal TAC Projects DBA and Scripting Engineer works with Technical Assistance Center (TAC) teams to coordinate database requirements for all Synapse applications, improve support readiness, and streamline processes for database project work. This role develops, implements, and continuously improves on the Active Monitoring solution for Synapse databases and related environments to support visibility into system health, performance, availability, and potential support issues. This engineers also works with other Principal roles to develop and supply all database-related training.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Handles all Synapse related database requests for the TAC Project team.
  • Works closely with other Principal TAC engineers for depth and continuity.
  • Helps with the development of new or improves on the existing cross training methodology from the database perspective.
  • Works to identify more efficient ways for the TAC team to handle DB related requests for creating customer custom scripts, DB extracts, and common DB related work such as MRN conversions.
  • Understand challenges that our customers and engineers face and help develop TAC processes to enhance the support experience both internally and externally.
  • Occasionally participates in customer site visits, as necessary.
  • Maintains an expert working knowledge on all DB technologies, current medical imaging products, and related technologies by staying abreast with the latest industry / technology advances through continuous education.
  • Learns and remains compliant with all regulatory and quality requirements.
  • Occasionally participates in customer site visits, as necessary.
  • Potential short notice and / or overnight travel, as required, to work on customer systems.
  • Working outside of normal business hours, overtime and holidays may be required based on the needs of the business.
  • Adheres to the Company's quality and regulatory compliance requirements, without exception, and ensures that all job duties inherent in the position description are performed in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Complies with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations and standards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Oracle Certification (OCA or Higher)
  • Minimum of 10 years of industry related professional experience.
  • Advanced DBA level knowledge of all current Synapse Applications.
  • Advanced knowledge of clinical data transfer protocols and interfaces (HL7 and DICOM).
  • Advanced working knowledge of current Synapse Applications.
  • Advanced knowledge of Synapse workflows and their implementations.
  • Advanced knowledge in Synapse application front end.
  • Advanced knowledge of medical informatics architecture (VMware and Storage Solutions).
  • Ability to achieve results and meet goals in a fast-paced, team environment.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills, excellent phone manner.
  • Ability to make independent decisions based on interpretation of technology data and product knowledge.
  • Excellent organizational and multi-tasking skills.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master’s Degree
  • SQL Certifications
  • Industry-specific certifications in relevant technical background (Microsoft, VMware, Cisco certifications)
  • Security Certifications (Security + or higher)

Physical requirements:

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

  • The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk, and hear for 75% of applicable work time.

Travel:

  • Occasional (up to 10%) travel may be required based on business needs.

*

Applicants to positions where vendor credentialing or other similar requirements exist to enter facilities will be required to comply with the credentialing requirements of the facilities, including complying with vaccine requirements. For all positions, the Company encourages vaccination against COVID-19 and requires that the successful candidate hired be willing to test for the COVID-19 virus periodically and wear a face covering indoors as required, absent being granted an accommodation due to medical or sincerely held religious belief or other legally required exemption.

Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc.

JOB DESCRIPTION
ACCOUNT DIRECTOR
Account Services
Reports to SVP, Group Account Director


Job Summary


The Account Director is responsible for managing key client relationships and overseeing the development and execution of medical communication strategies. This role involves providing strategic guidance to pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare clients, ensuring that medical education programs, scientific publications, and promotional content meet client objectives and regulatory standards. The Account Director will lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, timely projects while driving client satisfaction, account growth, and profitability. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in medical communications, client management, and team leadership, focusing on delivering scientifically accurate and impactful communications across various channels.
Key Job Responsibilities(Duties may include, but are not limited to all or some of the following)
  • Demonstrates commercial business development acumen, bringing a level of industry and therapeutic area knowledge unequaled inside or outside the client’s organization
  • Able to discuss, recommend, and provide direction on issues ranging from strategy to competitive market events in medical education
  • Owns the application of brand strategy into the master tactical plan development and tactical execution for their brand
  • Discusses, recommends, and provides direction on issues ranging from strategy to medical education tactics
  • Takes a lead role in fostering a partnership between planning and creative teams, resulting in strategic insight and vision that achieves client goals
  • Leads the team in a manner that encourages, executes on, and supports company ideals
  • Addresses conflict and celebrates successes, sets clear team priorities, explains brands’ objectives and strategies, monitors progress and measurable outcomes
  • Handles financial reporting, including month-over-month forecasting and accountability, maximizing profitability for his or her book of business, managing staff utilization and ensuring organic growth
  • Enables and promotes confidence in junior colleagues, peers, and cross-discipline client teams
  • Manages, mentors, and develops team members
  • Willing to travel including weekends






2
Job Qualifications(Skills/Requirements)
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 5-8 years of pharmaceutical marketing or account management experience in medical education, with at least 2-4 years of Account experience in an agency setting, is required
  • Possesses a level of business acumen and maturity necessary to lead a team
  • Ability to think "bigger picture" on the brand and for the agency in a strategic way that has a measurable impact on business results beyond tactical execution
  • Professional presence—possesses positive, inspirational qualities that motivate the internal team and evoke ease and confidence in clients
  • Possesses superior verbal and written communication skills, both with clients and internal brand teams, including presentation skills
  • Can mindfully manage deadlines, multiple tasks, and challenges
  • Strong understanding of medical communications, including scientific publications, medical education, digital communication, and promotional content.
  • Proven Experience in managing client relationships and leading the execution of complex projects across multiple channels.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex scientific information to clients and internal teams.
  • Experience in financial management, including budgeting and forecasting, focusing on achieving account profitability.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to mentor and guide cross-functional teams to success.
  • Ability to travel (locally and nationally) up to 25% of the time
  • Willingness to go beyond what is described in the job description and be flexible for the team and, ultimately, the work

raw.description:
“Real people, real partnership, real impact.”

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs with global talent.

This role focuses on the relationship between our Clients and our Talent and overseeing the health of those partnerships: supporting onboarding processes, tactically advising on best practices for collaboration, proactively addressing instances of misalignment, and ensuring a productive and supportive working relationship for the long haul.

Position - Customer Success Manager

The Customer Success Manager plays a key role in laying the foundation for a successful Client/Talent Partnership and ensuring both parties are working together harmoniously throughout their lifecycle as a pairing.

In designing and guiding Clients through a structured, custom onboarding process; checking in throughout the relationship to advise on best practices and document partnership health; and addressing misalignment in a dynamic manner, the Customer Success Manager acts as as a facilitator and cultural translator for the Client/Talent partnership, to increase mutual satisfaction and prevent service-level churn.

This is a full-time, remote position open to applicants in the US.

Accountability

You will have four primary areas of focus, with the expectation that you will be measured on your ability to design and execute customized onboarding flows; bridge complex cultural gaps through effective communication and translation; push back on outsized expectations to problem solve before issues arise; and proactively own your partnership portfolio. That means:

  • Facilitating calls with Clients and Talent in the earliest stages of their partnership, to get them set up to work together and ensure alignment in their individual ways of working
  • Managing Client dissatisfaction or misalignment to productive ends
  • Maintaining infrastructure to support satisfaction and growth, including Hubspot and Slack for collaboration, Gemini and Claude for AI enablement, and Google Sheets for partnership data and tracking
  • Acting as the voice of the Client/Talent Partnership in our internal development process.

Colleagues

Your primary partners are our Clients and Talent: facilitating onboarding calls, aligning on expectations, tactically advising Clients on how best to use our services, and “marriage counseling” through tough conversations to foster the health of each relationship. You’ll also work with our Internal Talent Success and Training Teams to ensure they have the insight, leverage, and support they need to help our Talent perform at their best.

While working cross-functionally, this role reports to the Head of Customer Success.

Requirements

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped people with one area of deep vertical expertise and broad horizontal interests. As a Customer Success Manager, the legs of your T should be in deeply understanding the needs of our Clients (primarily early stage startup founders who need operational and business process support) and ideal behaviors of our Talent (relentlessly forward-thinking and proactive operators) at 30,000 feet, and ensuring they can work together at ground level. Your arms should extend to an understanding of how businesses function, how they onboard and utilize new employees, where any manager might encounter hurdles in working with a direct report, and where global talent fits within these systems. Previous experience working with Founders in any capacity, or as a Former Founder yourself, is strongly preferred. Alternatively, previous tenure in Customer/Client Success or Account Management role at a fast-moving startup will be an asset as well, alongside exposure to the outsourcing industry more broadly.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to be able to manage, work with, and serve people from a broad range of backgrounds in an inclusive manner that supports both individual and collective dignity.

The interview process will include opportunities to demonstrate skills in each of the following areas:

  • Relationship Management: Are you able to position yourself as a trusted, expert partner to your Client as they embark on their first dive with us?
  • Expectation Management: Are you able to clearly and candidly outline where a Client's expectations might be outsized, and guide them towards behaviors that will generate the best outcomes within their working relationship?
  • Strategic Judgment: Are you able to work alongside other teams to quickly game out scenarios and present recommendations to Clients that serve both their needs as well as the needs of the business?
  • Dynamic Problem Solving: Where complex needs present themselves, are you able to instinctively design customized, in-the-moment solutions to foundationally support a productive and efficient working relationship?
  • Cross-Cultural Understanding: Are you able to understand and analyze subtext and context clues to identify hidden misalignment and maladaptive ways of working?

Benefits

The salary range for this role is $65,000-$85,000. It is fully-remote. Information about our benefits and how we arrived at this compensation range, along with an opportunity to update our understanding of both market and individual factors, will be available during our offer process.

About Oceans

Our company’s business model is simple: helping people in the developing world access employment opportunities in larger markets, at wages that support their individual dignity. We welcome the chance to discuss the complementary parts of our business during your interview process and encourage questions about where we are and where we are going.
