raw.description:
Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and more than 185 outpatient imaging centers across 13 states, our team conducts more than 4 million outpatient studies annually. We are the partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best-in-class clinical excellence, operations, and state-of-the-art technology across our platform.

AI Solutions Architect Role Overview Lumexa Imaging is seeking an experienced AI Solutions Architect to lead the design and delivery of AI-driven solutions across business and operational functions. This role will report to the SVP of AI Integrations and work closely with the AI and IT teams, as well as the enterprise-wide AI Governance Council to intake requests, define solution approaches, and ensure seamless integration of AI into enterprise workflows. This role requires a blend of enterprise solution architecture and hands-on AI implementation capability, with the ability to both design scalable solutions and independently build or prototype AI-driven workflows where needed. The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, deep understanding of enterprise system architecture, and the ability to translate ambiguous problem statements into scalable, practical AI solutions. While the primary focus is on business and operational use cases, familiarity with radiology and imaging workflows is highly preferred. This role operates across the full lifecycle of AI initiatives, from intake and scoping through solution design, integration, and stakeholder alignment, supporting a structured pipeline of enterprise AI opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Solution Design & Architecture
  • Lead end-to-end solution design for AI use cases, from intake through implementation planning
  • Translate business problems into technical architectures, workflows, and system integration designs

• Determine when to:

◦ Leverage existing enterprise tools and platforms, vs. ◦ Recommend new vendors, capabilities, or configuration changes

  • Define solution components including data flows, APIs, integrations, and user workflows
  • Hands-on AI Development & Prototyping
  • Independently design, prototype, and implement AI-enabled solutions, particularly for LLM-driven and workflow-based use cases
  • Rapidly develop MVPs and proof-of-concepts to validate solution feasibility and business value
  • Configure and leverage enterprise AI tools (e.g., copilots, automation platforms, embedded AI features) to deliver solutions
  • Progress solutions from prototype to scalable implementation in collaboration with engineering where needed
  • AI Project Intake & Scoping
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify problem statements, desired outcomes, and success metrics
  • Conduct structured intake and scope feasibility, level of effort, and dependencies
  • Align proposed solutions with enterprise priorities, governance standards, and KPIs
  • Contribute to and help manage the AI project pipeline and prioritization process
  • Workflow Integration & Optimization
  • Design solutions that integrate seamlessly into existing operational and clinical-adjacent workflows
  • Map current-state vs. future-state workflows and identify efficiency gains and automation opportunities
  • Ensure solutions are usable, scalable, and aligned with end-user needs
  • Partner with IT and operations teams to support implementation and adoption
  • Stakeholder Management & Change Enablement
  • Serve as a key interface between business leaders, IT, clinical stakeholders, and vendors
  • Facilitate working sessions to gather requirements, validate designs, and drive alignment
  • Navigate a matrixed organization with competing priorities and stakeholders
  • Clearly communicate tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations
  • Vendor & Technology Evaluation
  • Evaluate AI tools, platforms, and vendors for fit, scalability, security, and ROI
  • Develop recommendations including build vs. buy decisions
  • Partner with governance, legal, and security teams to support vendor selection and risk review
  • Execution Support & Continuous Improvement
  • Collaborate with AI engineering and product teams to ensure effective execution of designed solutions
  • Monitor performance against defined KPIs and identify opportunities to improve outcomes
  • Contribute to evolving AI architecture standards, best practices, and playbooks

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, or technology consulting
  • Proven experience designing and implementing cross-system workflows and integrations

• Strong understanding of:

◦ Enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, CRM, RCM, scheduling, contact center) ◦ APIs, data integration, and system interoperability

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Ability to leverage and configure underlying technical components (e.g., APIs, data flows, orchestration tools, and data sources) to independently design and implement AI-driven solutions, including LLM-based applications (e.g., prompt-driven workflows, copilots, document processing, or conversational interfaces)
  • Strong understanding of how to apply AI appropriately within enterprise workflows, including awareness of limitations, tradeoffs, and risks
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business audiences
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
  • Excellent project scoping, prioritization, and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders with varying levels of technical and operational fluency
  • Demonstrated ability and strong desire to continuously learn and adapt in a rapidly evolving AI landscape, including proactively staying current on emerging tools, capabilities, and best practices and translating that knowledge into practical enterprise applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience scaling AI solutions from prototype to enterprise deployment
  • Familiarity with healthcare operations and radiology workflows (PACS, RIS, scheduling, center operations) a strong plus
  • Strong understanding of healthcare regulations (e.g., HIPAA, FDA) and compliance requirements related to AI in healthcare
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) and tools relevant to AI and healthcare solutions
  • Experience in vendor evaluation, procurement, and solution selection
  • Exposure to AI governance, compliance, or data security considerations

Success Profile

  • Self-starter: Proactively identifies opportunities and drives work forward with minimal direction
  • Structured thinker: Brings clarity to ambiguous problems and defines actionable paths
  • Hands-on and pragmatic: Comfortable building and iterating on solutions directly to accelerate progress
  • Business-oriented: Focuses on practical, high-impact outcomes over theoretical solutions
  • Collaborative but decisive: Seeks input and effectively engages stakeholders while driving clarity
  • Orchestrator: Aligns diverse stakeholders and keeps parallel workstreams moving across a matrixed environment
  • Continuous learner: Maintains an open mindset and actively stays current on emerging AI capabilities, rapidly translating new developments into real-world use cases
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-evolving AI and enterprise environment

Example Scope of Work

  • Automating back-office workflows (e.g., finance, RCM, HR, contact center)
  • Designing and deploying LLM-enabled workflow automation and decision support tools for operational efficiency
  • Integrating AI capabilities into existing enterprise systems
  • Supporting clinical-adjacent workflows (e.g., scheduling, reporting support, center operations)

Lumexa Imaging provides a competitive compensation program to attract, retain, and motivate a high-performance workforce.

Lumexa Imaging is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

As the Senior Collections Analyst, Enterprise & Strategic Collections— U.S., you will own collections strategy and execution for a defined portfolio of Motive’s largest and most complex U.S. Enterprise and Strategic accounts. These accounts require dedicated, high-touch coverage because of their scale, contractual or billing complexity, relationship sensitivity, or elevated financial risk.

Reporting directly to the Senior Manager, Collections, you will partner closely with customer finance and accounts-payable stakeholders and with Motive’s Account Management, Customer Success, Billing, Revenue Accounting, and Order Management teams to resolve issues, secure payment commitments, and improve cash outcomes while protecting long-term customer relationships. You will maintain clear account-level risk and cash-forecast visibility and help improve the workflows and handoffs used across the broader collections organization.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. Account assignment should be based on portfolio complexity, customer needs, and business risk; routine or standardized accounts may remain in shared-service workflows.

What You'll Do:

  • Own end-to-end collections strategy and execution for a portfolio of large U.S. Enterprise and Strategic customers, prioritizing actions based on amount, aging, payment behavior, dispute status, and risk.
  • Build and maintain customer-specific collection plans, stakeholder maps, payment timelines, and escalation paths; serve as a trusted collections contact for customer finance and accounts-payable stakeholders.
  • Secure, document, and actively monitor promises to pay; follow through on missed commitments and escalate material risks promptly.
  • Partner with Account Management, Customer Success, Billing, Revenue Accounting, and Order Management to resolve invoice, contract, purchase-order, service, and payment-blocking issues.
  • Balance customer partnership with clear, consistent follow-through on contractual payment obligations; communicate risks and next steps with sound judgment and professionalism.
  • Maintain accurate account notes, invoice status, dispute reasons, payment commitments, and collection forecasts in the systems of record.
  • Provide reliable cash, aging, and at-risk-account updates; explain forecast changes, material variances, and expected timing of collections to leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • Identify and escalate credit, delinquency, and bad-debt risks; contribute account-level analysis to reserve, write-off, and close discussions with Revenue Accounting.
  • Lead or contribute to reviews of high-risk and strategically important accounts, aligning owners and actions across teams until issues are resolved.
  • Identify recurring process, policy, reporting, and system issues that slow collections; recommend practical improvements and help test or implement scalable fixes and automation.
  • Coordinate with the broader global collections team on account handoffs, coverage, and escalation criteria to ensure consistent customer context and a clear owner.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience in Collections, Accounts Receivable, or Finance Operations
  • Deep experience designing and scaling collections processes, including automation, dunning strategy, and high-volume, low-touch recovery models.
  • Experience using automation and AI to improve workflow design, prioritization, and collections outcomes.
  • Experience managing day-to-day portfolio health, including account health, invoice status, collections forecasting, and timely cash application.
  • Experience with international collections across markets such as Canada and the UK/EU.
  • Strong analytical skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to use data to drive decisions and outcomes.
  • Ability to partner effectively across Revenue Accounting, Billing, Order Management, and customer-facing Account teams.
  • Demonstrated success managing Enterprise and Strategic collections in a relationship-sensitive environment.
  • Deep experience with Zuora Billing is strongly preferred; experience with other billing or ERP platforms is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.

Pay Transparency
Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visitingMotive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the compensation range is:

United States
$88,000—$121,000 USD

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

(“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.

raw.description:
Title: Senior Customer Success Manager

Location: United States, REMOTE

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Senior Customer Success Managers own the relationship that determines whether a customer renews, expands, and becomes an advocate — or quietly churns. You are the person accountable for making sure customers realize measurable value from our Predictive Revenue System, translating platform capability into revenue outcomes their leadership can see.

This is not a reactive support role. You will manage a book of business proactively — using product usage data, AI-surfaced health signals, and your own commercial judgment to intervene before problems become risks and to spot expansion opportunities before the customer asks. You will be the voice of the customer inside Salesloft and the trusted advisor the customer relies on outside it.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Own retention, adoption, and net revenue expansion across a defined book of business, translating each customer's goals into a clear plan for realizing value from the platform.
  • Use AI-surfaced customer health signals, product usage data, and engagement scoring to prioritize proactively — acting first on the accounts and moments that matter most.
  • Lead strategic business reviews with customer stakeholders and executives, connecting platform usage to measurable revenue outcomes and ROI.
  • Partner with Account Management to identify and drive expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated value.
  • Advocate for customers cross-functionally — bringing structured product feedback to Product and Engineering and coordinating internal resources to resolve challenges.
  • Drive adoption through tailored enablement, onboarding support, and ongoing strategic guidance that keeps customers progressing toward their goals.

This role lives at the heart of how we are Customer Inspired: every action you take is measured against a single question — does this make our customer more successful? And in the spirit of how we Lead From the Front, you'll use the same AI-powered platform our customers use, bringing applied curiosity to how technology can scale the value you deliver across your entire book.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a commercially minded relationship builder who understands that customer success is a revenue discipline, not a support function. You are equally comfortable running an executive business review and digging into usage data to find the signal that tells you where to focus next.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you bring data to customer conversations rather than assumption, you let health signals and outcomes guide where you spend your time, and you're honest with customers about what will and won't move them forward. You are proactive by nature, energized by ownership, and motivated by seeing customers win.

This is the right role if you want to own real commercial outcomes at a company whose platform is redefining how revenue teams operate.

THE TEAM

The Salesloft Customer Success organization is responsible for the retention, adoption, and growth of our customer base — the team that ensures the value we sell is the value customers actually realize. CSMs here operate as trusted advisors and commercial owners, working closely with Account Management, Support, Product, and Marketing.

The team Moves as One — success, sales, and support operate with shared ownership of customer outcomes, surfacing risks and opportunities directly rather than passing them between functions. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: the entire team measures itself by customer success, not internal activity metrics, because a renewed and expanding customer is the only result that counts.

THE SKILL SET

  • Proven track record in a Customer Success, Account Management, or post-sale role at a B2B SaaS company, with direct ownership of retention and expansion outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a book of business and consistently meet or exceed retention and net revenue expansion targets.
  • Comfort working with product usage data and customer health signals to prioritize action and drive decisions.
  • Strong executive presence — the ability to run business reviews and build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate platform capability into business outcomes a customer's leadership will value.
  • Experience with a sales engagement, revenue intelligence, or revenue operations platform — Salesloft, Clari, Gong, Outreach, or adjacent tools.

About Niyam IT (Niyam)

Founded in 2007 by a team of visionary consultants, Niyam IT was built on the belief that exceptional technology solutions are created through the perfect balance of disciplined processes, innovation, and passion. For nearly 20 years, we have been a trusted partner to the U.S. Federal Government, delivering mission-critical IT solutions that support Emergency Preparedness and Response, Civilian Agencies, Law Enforcement, and Public Safety organizations across the nation.

At Niyam, excellence is more than a goal. It is embedded in everything we do. Our commitment to quality, security, and continuous improvement is demonstrated through our CMMI DEV Level 3 accreditation, ISO certifications (ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 20000-1, and ISO/IEC 27001), and active CMMC Level 2 certification.

We are committed to fostering an exceptional workplace where employees are empowered to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact. Niyam is proud to have been recognized by The Washington Post as a Top Workplace for two consecutive years and named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies for four consecutive years. These achievements reflect our unwavering commitment to cultivating a culture built on collaboration, excellence, innovation, and the success of our employees.

Join Niyam and become part of a team where your talents help drive meaningful missions that serve and protect communities nationwide.

What We Offer

  • Flexible Work Hours: We understand that life extends beyond the traditional workday. Our flexible scheduling options empower you to balance your professional responsibilities while making time for what matters most.

  • Innovative & Collaborative Culture: We foster an environment where creativity is encouraged, ideas are valued, and teamwork drives success. At Niyam, innovation and collaboration are part of our DNA.

Join us in creating a workplace where innovation, diversity, and well-being thrive. Your journey at Niyam awaits. Apply today!

Niyam is seeking an IBM Maximo Trainerto develop and deliver training programs for maintenance, asset management, inventory, procurement, and work management processes within IBM Maximo environments. Skilled in conducting instructor-led and virtual training sessions, creating user guides and training materials, and supporting system implementations, upgrades, and process improvements. Adept at translating complex technical concepts into practical, user-friendly instruction for employees at all levels. Strong knowledge of enterprise asset management (EAM) best practices, user adoption strategies, and change management initiatives. Proven ability to work collaboratively with business stakeholders, system administrators, and end users to ensure successful Maximo utilization and operational efficiency.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver training sessions for system configuration and implementation of IBM Maximo, including comprehensive, electronic, and editable training materials and supporting documentation.
  • Participate in Agile sprint activities to support project planning, development, implementation, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct and contribute to training research, needs assessments, and analyses to identify learning requirements and improve training effectiveness.
  • Facilitate train-the-trainer sessions to prepare designated personnel to effectively deliver training and support end users.
  • Provide senior-level guidance to project teams and develop, update, and maintain training documentation reflecting newly implemented features, system enhancements, and configuration changes.
  • Lead requirements-gathering activities through stakeholder interviews, design workshops, discovery sessions, and business process reviews to identify business needs, define use cases, and establish functional requirements.
  • Translate business and operational needs into comprehensive Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, workflow diagrams, process maps, and other project deliverables.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration among business stakeholders, technical teams, and project personnel to ensure alignment of requirements, expectations, and project objectives throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Develop, maintain, and manage technical and functional documentation, including system configuration guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs), training materials, user guides, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support project team members in conducting analyses, evaluating existing systems and processes, and developing and documenting recommendations for system improvements, optimization, and maintenance across information systems architecture, automation, communications protocols, risk management, software development, lifecycle management, modeling and simulation, and requirements management.
  • Provide comprehensive support throughout the project lifecycle, including scope definition, business case development, requirements elicitation, functional and technical design, testing, training, implementation, and post-implementation support.
  • Available to travel up to four (4) times per year.

Qualifications and Education Requirements:

  • US Citizenship with ability to obtain a Public Trust.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related technical field.
  • 4+ years of hand-on experience as a trainer and business analyst.

Preferred Skills:

  • Prior experience working on federal contracts.
  • Prior experience in training in IBM Maximo systems.

Why Join Niyam

  • Award-Winning Culture: Proudly recognized by The Washington Post as a Top Workplace for two consecutive years and named to the Inc. 5000 list of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to employee engagement, growth, and excellence.
  • Meaningful Mission Impact: Join a small business trusted by federal agencies to deliver innovative solutions that support critical national missions.
  • Drive Innovation: Play a key role in shaping the future of Niyam’s proprietary technology accelerators, including GeoCube®, SPHERE®, and RisQ®, which are used to solve complex challenges across the federal government.
  • Accelerate Your Career: Benefit from a transparent career framework designed to support continuous learning, professional development, and advancement opportunities, including progression to Distinguished Engineer and other technical leadership roles.
  • Collaborative, People-First Environment: Work alongside talented professionals who are passionate about innovation, teamwork, and delivering exceptional results while supporting one another's success.

Join Niyam and help us win the work that matters.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Design and build a new eCommerce website for a Palestinian fashion brand rooted in tatreez, ready for a new collection launch.
Organization: Confidential client in the fashion/retail sector; the name will be shared with shortlisted candidates before the client interview
Location: Remote - open to candidates in Palestine, especially Gaza
Role Type:Project-based | Consultant-contractor | Fixed term (launch by end of year, no later than January)
Reports to: Brand Founder
The opportunity
Our client is a small, slowly growing Palestinian fashion brand built around tatreez. They are seeking a Website Designer (Shopify) to design and launch a brand-new website. In this role, you will take the brand's existing logo, color kit, photography, and content and turn them into a polished, accessible online home that immediately communicates who the brand is. This is a launch of something new rather than maintenance of existing pages: the current self-built site is not functional, no product pages exist yet, and everything needs to be ready before a new collection arrives at the end of the year.
About the organization
Our client's longer-term vision is to grow the brand into a small fashion house: hiring Palestinian makers to create tatreez pieces, and offering workshops where people can learn tatreez beyond the basics and tell their own story through stitching. All current sales happen through Shopify, and the site needs to serve two audiences at once: people who want to purchase, and people who want to learn.

What you will do

  • Design and implement the full build in Shopify, the platform where all of the client's sales live.
  • Set up shop and checkout for fewer than 10 products, plus digital patterns available for purchase.
  • Build an Events page where people can purchase workshops and join monthly community circles.
  • Create space for educational content and a blog, alongside a tatreez pattern library serving both learners and buyers.
  • Design clear paths through the site: one for people who want to purchase, one for people who want to learn.
  • Customize the theme at a level beyond a stock template: editing layouts, sections, and product templates (via the theme editor and/or Liquid/HTML/CSS).
  • Ensure the site is accessible, easy to navigate, and ready for handoff so a non-technical owner can maintain it herself.

What you bring

  • Portfolio showing eCommerce sites built in Shopify.
  • Experience designing and building sites that mix purposes: store, marketing/content pages, and event or education pages.
  • Shopify theme customization experience: editing layouts, sections, and product templates via the theme editor and/or Liquid/HTML/CSS, not just installing and lightly tweaking a stock theme.
  • Experience building product pages, digital product purchases, a blog, and an events/booking page in Shopify.
  • A design approach that prioritizes accessibility.
  • Availability to begin and complete the work by end of year or early January at the latest.
  • Basic English is sufficient; the client speaks some Arabic herself, and strong English is not required.

Helpful, but not essential

  • SEO knowledge.
  • Experience with digital pattern or downloadable product sales.
  • Interest in or familiarity with tatreez, Palestinian craft, or heritage brands.
How the engagement works
Contracting party: You will contract directly with Apricot, which will manage contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support. Day to day, you will work directly with the brand's founder.
For this project-based engagement, the timeline is fixed: launch before the end of the year, ideally no later than January, ahead of a new collection. Working hours are flexible with no fixed schedule required. The site must be delivered in a clean, maintainable state: the client will handle her own ongoing updates to products, blog posts, and the events page, so simple self-service upkeep is the goal. The client will provide her logo, color kit, all photography, and all content.
Planned check-ins are scheduled per each delivered milestone to see how the engagement is working and help address any issues.
About Apricot
Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

raw.description:
Charger Logistics Inc. is a leading asset-based transportation company with over 20 years of experience delivering innovative logistics solutions. We have evolved into a world-class transport provider and continue to expand across North America.

We're looking for a Sr Cloud Network Engineer to design, build and run the network that connects our cloud platforms, offices and terminals across North America. Our systems run 24/7 to support trucking and logistics operations, so the network has to be fast, secure and always available. You'll work closely with our infrastructure, SRE, security and development teams in Canada.

Please note this is a Contract opportunity for potential to convert in a permanent role..

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and manage cloud networks (VPCs/VNets, subnets, routing, peering) across GCP, Azure and AWS.
  • Set up and maintain secure connections between cloud environments, data centres and our offices and terminals, using site-to-site VPN, Cloud Interconnect, ExpressRoute or Direct Connect.
  • Manage cloud load balancers, DNS, NAT and network gateways for our production services.
  • Configure and maintain firewalls, security groups and network policies to keep traffic secure.
  • Support networking for our Kubernetes platform (ingress, network policies, service-to-service traffic).
  • Build and manage network infrastructure as code with Terraform.
  • Monitor network performance, troubleshoot latency and connectivity issues, and take part in an on-call rotation.
  • Support zero-trust and secure remote access tools such as Zscaler, Cloudflare or Palo Alto Prisma.
  • Document network designs and keep diagrams and runbooks up to date.
  • Plan for capacity, high availability and disaster recovery, and help manage cloud networking costs.

Requirements

  • 6–8 years in network engineering, including at least 2–3 years with cloud networking.
  • Hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud (GCP, Azure or AWS). More than one is a plus.
  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting, routing (BGP, OSPF), DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPN and load balancing.
  • Experience with hybrid connectivity between on-premises sites and the cloud.
  • Hands-on with firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco or cloud-native firewalls).
  • Infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar.
  • Scripting in Python, Bash or PowerShell for automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills using tools like Wireshark, traceroute and cloud flow logs.

Nice to have

  • Kubernetes networking (CNI, ingress controllers, service mesh)
  • SD-WAN experience (Cisco, Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud or similar)
  • Zero-trust or SASE tools: Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope or Prisma Access
  • Certifications such as CCNP, Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer, AWS Advanced Networking Specialty or Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
  • Experience in logistics, transportation or another 24/7 operations environment

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary
  • Healthcare Benefit Package
  • Career Growth

About Vyne

Vyne is a healthcare technology company focused on helping dental practices and payers simplify and accelerate the revenue cycle. Serving more than 84,000 dental offices and hundreds of health plans and payers across the United States, Vyne provides integrated technology that streamlines claims, attachments, eligibility, and patient payment workflows.

By replacing fragmented, manual, and paper-based processes with modern, connected solutions, Vyne helps practices reduce administrative burden, improve efficiency, accelerate revenue, and spend more time focused on their patients.

At Vyne, you'll work alongside people who are passionate about what they do and genuinely invested in each other's success. As part of a remote-first organization, employees benefit from flexibility and work-life balance while collaborating to solve meaningful challenges across the dental industry. The work is impactful, the environment is collaborative, and our teams are united by a shared commitment to making healthcare work better.

Position Overview

Title of Position: Sales Team Lead (Player-Coach)

Classification: Exempt / Full-Time

Organizational Relationship: Reports to Director of Sales

Location: Remote

Remote Work Eligibility: This position is fully remote and there is a strong preference for employees residing in Utah, Indiana, Georgia, or Tennessee.

General Summary

The Sales Team Lead - Dental is a player-coach responsible for leading a team of up to six Vyne Account Executives (AEs) and helping deliver predictable new-business growth across the dental market. This leader spends approximately 70% of their time coaching and managing the team, and approximately 30% selling a defined book of business. The team's results come first.

This role is for a proven seller who is ready to lead. The successful candidate will use data to diagnose performance, coach to specific skill and habit gaps, hold AEs accountable with empathy, and stay close enough to the market to credibly model great selling, without letting their own quota pull attention away from the team.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of up to six Account Executives (AEs) through weekly 1:1s, call and demo reviews, live deal support, and written development plans.
  • Contribute directly to team quota attainment and new-business bookings by raising the performance of every AE, with a focus on increasing the number of AEs who consistently reach quota.
  • Use Salesforce, Dialpad, and Outreach data to identify gaps in AE skills, habits, pipeline, conversion, and execution, and translate those insights into specific coaching actions and measurable improvement.
  • Run a disciplined weekly operating cadence for pipeline review, deal inspection, forecasting, qualification, next-step discipline, and CRM hygiene, and ensure the team's forecast is accurate and submitted on time.
  • Carry a defined personal quota on an assigned book of business (approximately 30% of time), selling credibly and modeling Vyne's sales motion.
  • Coach and model a consultative, value-based, Challenger-oriented sales approach that connects Vyne solutions to outcomes dental practices care about.
  • Onboard and ramp new AEs, participate in recruiting and interviewing, and partner with the Director of Sales to address performance issues early and fairly.
  • Partner with Business Development, Marketing, Partnerships, Product, Revenue Operations, and Customer teams to improve lead handoffs, pipeline creation, positioning, enablement, customer proof points, and market feedback.
  • Give the Director of Sales clear visibility into team performance, risks, capacity, and actions required, and provide input on territory design, quota setting, and incentive structure.

Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned as needed to support business and organizational objectives.

Education, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in dental technology, healthcare technology, SaaS, or a related environment, with a record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota as an individual contributor.
  • Experience leading or coaching other sellers, whether as a team lead, sales manager, trainer, or informal mentor, with demonstrated ability to improve the performance of others.
  • Strong command of pipeline management, forecasting, conversion metrics, CRM discipline, and the use of data to diagnose performance gaps and drive action.
  • Experience with a consultative, value-based, Challenger, or comparable insight-led sales methodology, and the ability to teach it through call reviews and live coaching.
  • Ability to balance selling and managing, and to put the team's results ahead of personal production when the two compete for time.
  • Dental industry experience and knowledge of dental practice operations, DSOs, dental technology, or revenue-cycle workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to lead effectively in a remote or geographically distributed environment and partner cross-functionally.
  • Strong communication, judgment, accountability, urgency, and results orientation; proficiency with Salesforce, Outreach, Dialpad, or comparable sales technologies; ability to travel as needed.

Benefits & Perks

Vyne offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, financial well-being, families, and lifestyles of our employees, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Retirement savings benefits
  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Family support benefits, including diaper and wipes assistance for eligible employees during the first year

  • Flexible and remote work opportunities, where applicable

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on position, employment status, location, and applicable plan terms.

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Rust Developer to design, build, and optimize high-performance distributed systems, low-latency backend services, and cloud-native infrastructure components powering mission-critical enterprise platforms. This role focuses on developing highly concurrent, memory-safe applications using Rust while integrating with modern cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and event-driven architectures.
You will work closely with platform engineers, distributed systems architects, DevOps teams, and product engineering groups to build scalable APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, networking services, and infrastructure automation tools. The ideal candidate has strong systems programming expertise, deep knowledge of concurrent application development, and experience building production software where performance, reliability, and security are critical.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop high-performance backend services using Rust for large-scale distributed systems.
  • Build low-latency APIs, asynchronous processing services, and event-driven microservices.
  • Develop networking applications utilizing TCP, UDP, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets, and QUIC protocols.
  • Build highly concurrent applications using Rust's async ecosystem including Tokio and async/await.
  • Design resilient services capable of processing millions of transactions with high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Optimize CPU utilization, memory management, thread scheduling, and application performance.
  • Integrate services with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Develop secure APIs and authentication services supporting OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect, and mTLS.
  • Build observability capabilities including structured logging, distributed tracing, and performance monitoring.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, system design discussions, and production support.
  • Collaborate with DevOps engineers to automate deployments using CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Investigate complex production issues involving networking, concurrency, memory utilization, and distributed systems.

Required Skills
  • Six or more years of professional software engineering experience building enterprise applications.
  • Three or more years of hands-on Rust development experience in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Rust programming language, ownership model, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, and macros.
  • Extensive experience with asynchronous Rust development using Tokio, async/await, Futures, and Actix or Axum.
  • Strong understanding of concurrent programming, multithreading, synchronization primitives, and lock-free programming concepts.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs, gRPC services, and high-performance backend applications.
  • Strong understanding of operating system fundamentals including memory management, process scheduling, file systems, and networking.
  • Experience working with Linux production environments and command-line tooling.
  • Experience developing cloud-native applications on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server.
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases such as Redis, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience integrating distributed messaging systems including Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, or Pulsar.
  • Strong debugging, profiling, benchmarking, and performance optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building distributed systems supporting high-throughput financial, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or telecommunications platforms.
  • Familiarity with Rust web frameworks including Axum, Warp, Rocket, or Actix Web.
  • Experience developing Kubernetes Operators or cloud-native infrastructure tooling.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Pulumi.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing platforms.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic libraries, TLS, secure communications, and certificate management.
  • Experience building command-line tools and systems utilities using Rust.
  • Familiarity with C/C++ interoperability through Foreign Function Interface (FFI).
  • Contributions to open-source Rust projects or participation in the Rust community are highly desirable.

Project Environment
You will be joining a platform engineering team responsible for building next-generation distributed infrastructure supporting enterprise-scale applications across cloud environments. Current initiatives include:
  • High-performance API gateway and service mesh components
  • Real-time event streaming and data processing pipelines
  • Distributed job scheduling and workflow orchestration services
  • Cloud-native platform services deployed on Kubernetes
  • Secure authentication and identity management infrastructure
  • Infrastructure automation and systems observability platforms
  • High-availability backend services processing millions of requests daily
  • Enterprise monitoring, telemetry, and reliability engineering solutions

This is a highly technical engineering role where you will contribute to architecture, implementation, performance optimization, deployment, and operational excellence for large-scale production systems.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;

About The Role

We’re looking for a creative, football-loving Freelance/ContractorSocial Media Manager to support our Danish team working on Prime Video’s social media channels, which holds Premier League broadcast rights. This is a flexible, fully remote, part-time opportunity of approximately 8-12 hours per week.

You’ll be responsible for helping create engaging, entertaining and reactive Premier League content for Danish audiences across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

From editing exciting match moments and creating eye-catcching graphics to coming up with creative content ideas and reacting to the biggest Premier League stories, you’ll play and important role in bringing football closer to the Danish fans.

You’ll work closely with our wider international team also working on other Prime Video Sport channels, with opportunities to collaborate across different markets.

Responsibilities

Content Creation
  • Create engaging Premier League content for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, from initial ideas through to publishing.
  • Edit short-form videos, including match highlights, player moments, interviews, documentaries and other football-related content.
  • Design graphics, carousels and other social assets using tools such as Adobe Photoshop and Premiere Pro.
  • Adapt existing templates and develop creative ideas that feel native to each platform. Stay on top of football trends, viral moments, memes and popular social media formats in Denmark.
  • Bring fresh, entertaining ideas that help our content stand out and encourage fans to engage.

Premier League & Live Matchday Coverage

  • Deliver reactive social media coverage during Prime Video’s Premier League broadcassts, primarily on weekends but also some evenings.
  • Identify exciting match moments, interesting storylines and opportunities for engaging content.
  • Quickly edit and publish relevant content during and after matches.
  • Follow Premier League news and identify stories that resonate with Danish football fans.
  • Work closely with the wider team to coordinate content during live coverage.

Social Media Management

  • Supporting the planning, scheduling and publishing of content across our Danish social media channels.
  • Write engaging Danish captions, headlines and social copy.
  • Understand what makes content successful across Instagram, Tiktok & YouTube.
  • Monitor content performance and use learnings to improve future posts.
  • Contribute creative ideas and participate in regular team discussions and planning.

Requirements

We’re looking for someone who loves football, understand social media and enjoys creating content.
  • Fluent or native-level Danish, with strong communication skills.
  • Good English communication skills.
  • A genuine passion for football and a strong interest in the Premier League.
  • Experience editing short-form videos for social media.
  • Experience creating graphics and visual content.
  • Familiarity with editing and design software such as Adobe Pemiere Pro, Photoshop, CapCut or similar tools.
  • A strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, including what makes content engaging and shareable.
  • Creative thinking and the ability to come up with original content ideas.
  • Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and react quickly to live events.
  • Availability to work during selected Premier League match days, typically on weekends.

Benefits

N/A - this is a Freelance/Contractor position

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Regional Director, Sales for Germany, you’ll lead a high-performing team of Strategic & Major Account Executive professionals to grow adoption of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll be responsible for managing software sales, bookings, and revenue, while building strong relationships with new and existing customers who rely on GitLab to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk. Reporting to the VP, Central EMEA, you’ll hire and develop top talent, set clear territory and industry strategies, and ensure your team’s sales plans align with GitLab’s overall growth goals in this market. Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Strategic & Major Account Executives focused on the German market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results

  • Practical experience working with CRM and sales/marketing tools (for example Salesforce, Clari, Marketo) to manage forecasts, territories, and pipeline
  • Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to inform territory planning and team enablement
  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills, including executive-level written and verbal communication and the ability to mentor others
  • Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in open source, with openness to candidates who bring transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets

raw.title: Vice President, Global Corporate Impact
raw.excerpt: Remote in the United States, Brazil, Canada, or Mexico Mercy For Animals aims to end industrial animal agriculture by constructing a just and sustainable food system.
raw.description:
Remote in the United States, Brazil, Canada, or Mexico

Mercy For Animals aims to end industrial animal agriculture by constructing a just and sustainable food system. We envision a world where animals are respected, protected, and free.

As a leading farmed animal advocacy organization, we know that achieving this goal requires a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative work environment—one that welcomes and sparks new perspectives and innovative ideas. If you are passionate about our mission, driven to make a big impact for animals, and eager to be part of a dedicated team, join us!

Mercy For Animals is entering a new chapter, sharpening our focus on the opportunities where we can achieve the greatest possible impact for animals. Corporate accountability is central to this work. We believe that changing the policies and practices of the world's most influential companies can meaningfully reduce or end suffering for billions of animals raised for food.

The Global Vice President of Corporate Impact will lead MFA's global corporate impact strategy, driving ambitious campaigns that secure meaningful corporate commitments, hold companies accountable for implementation, and produce measurable improvements in the lives of animals.

Reporting directly to the President & CEO, this leader will be responsible for MFA's global corporate campaigns and engagement team, while working closely with regional Managing Directors to align priorities, strengthen campaigning capabilities, and maximize impact across regions.

This is both a strategic and a hands-on leadership role. We are looking for an exceptional campaign strategist and organizational leader who understands how to influence powerful institutions, build leverage, negotiate effectively, and mobilize pressure when necessary. The successful candidate will combine bold ambition with sound judgment, disciplined execution, and a relentless focus on results.

You will do invaluable work:

Global Strategy, Prioritization & Impact

  • Partner with the CEO to define and execute MFA's global corporate impact strategy, establishing ambitious, measurable goals aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Identify and prioritize the companies, industries, markets, and opportunities where MFA can achieve the greatest improvements for animals, working closely with Intelligence & Impact and regional leadership.
  • Lead the global corporate impact portfolio, making disciplined decisions about where to invest time and resources, which initiatives to accelerate or adapt, and which to discontinue.
  • Translate strategic priorities into actionable and holistic campaign plans with clear objectives, accountable owners, milestones, budgets, and measures of success.
  • Establish and monitor meaningful performance indicators, with particular emphasis on corporate policy implementation, verified changes in company practices, and measurable animal impact, not simply commitments or activities.
  • Continuously evaluate campaign effectiveness, using MFA’s organization-wide impact framework, contribute to how that framework measures corporate interventions, adapt strategies as circumstances change, and identify opportunities to improve the impact and cost-effectiveness of MFA's work.
  • Advance corporate welfare reforms as a core priority, while evaluating opportunities for plant-forward and animal-protein-reduction initiatives where they align with MFA's strategy and can demonstrate meaningful impact for animals.

Corporate Campaigns, Engagement & Accountability

  • Lead the development, direction and execution of bold, sophisticated global corporate campaigns that change the policies and practices of major multinational companies.
  • Direct global campaign strategy from target selection and corporate engagement through negotiation, public pressure, escalation, commitment, and implementation.
  • Develop and deploy effective approaches to influencing corporate decision-makers, combining constructive engagement and negotiation with strategic advocacy and coordinated public pressure when necessary.
  • Establish clear, ambitious, and credible expectations for corporate commitments, including meaningful implementation timelines, transparent progress reporting, and mechanisms for accountability.
  • Ensure that MFA actively tracks corporate commitments and their implementation, identifies barriers to progress, and takes decisive action when companies fail to meet their obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to develop innovative campaign tactics, strengthen leverage, and build momentum across companies, industries, and markets.
  • Monitor trends in corporate behavior, animal agriculture, and food markets, and share insights with the Intelligence & Impact team to inform MFA’s broader strategy.
  • Work closely with investigations, marketing & communications, organizing, policy, and other relevant teams to bring the full strength of MFA's capabilities to priority campaigns.
  • Build and maintain relationships with corporate executives and other influential stakeholders, while maintaining MFA's independence and willingness to challenge powerful institutions.

Global Leadership & Regional Collaboration

  • Lead, develop, and empower a high-performing global corporate impact team, establishing a culture of ownership, courage, collaboration, accountability, and execution.
  • Set clear expectations, provide candid and constructive feedback, develop talent, and hold team members accountable for delivering results.
  • Partner closely with regional Managing Directors to establish shared corporate impact priorities, coordinate global campaigns, and strengthen alignment without creating unnecessary layers of management or approval.
  • Foster the exchange of effective tactics, market intelligence, and lessons learned across MFA's global operations, adapting approaches to local market conditions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve coordination, and leverage technology and AI to strengthen campaigning capabilities and organizational effectiveness.

Enterprise Leadership, Partnerships & Resource Stewardship

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and Senior Leadership Team, contributing to organizational strategy, resource allocation, priority setting, and major decisions affecting MFA's direction.
  • Collaborate with Intelligence & Impact to strengthen evidence-based decision-making, identify emerging opportunities, and rigorously assess the effectiveness of corporate interventions.
  • Cultivate strategic relationships and coalitions with other animal protection organizations and movement partners, aligning efforts when collaboration can meaningfully increase impact while preserving MFA's distinct contribution.
  • Represent MFA with corporate leaders, movement partners, funders, media, and other external stakeholders as appropriate.
  • Oversee the effective deployment of the global corporate impact budget, ensuring resources are aligned with strategic priorities and expected results.
  • Partner with Development and Finance to support compelling grant proposals, responsible stewardship of restricted funding, accurate reporting, and the achievement of funded program outcomes.

Your qualifications will take our team to the next level:

  • Significant leadership experience in corporate campaigning, corporate engagement, animal advocacy, or a closely related field, with a demonstrated record of achieving meaningful institutional or corporate change.
  • Proven ability to develop and lead sophisticated campaigns that influence major companies, secure meaningful commitments, and drive implementation and accountability.
  • Deep understanding of the global food industry, corporate supply chains, and the major animal welfare challenges associated with industrial animal agriculture.
  • Exceptional strategic judgment, with the ability to identify high-impact opportunities, make difficult tradeoffs, allocate resources effectively, and turn strategy into measurable results.
  • Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams, including experience working across different geographies and cultures.
  • Strong understanding of corporate power, incentives, negotiation, reputational pressure, public campaigning, and the conditions that lead institutions to change.
  • Ability to combine collaborative, constructive engagement with the conviction and determination to challenge powerful companies when necessary.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use evidence, performance data, and impact measurement to inform decisions and improve effectiveness.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills, including the credibility to engage senior corporate executives, coalition partners, funders, and organizational leadership.
  • A highly proactive, resourceful, and decisive leadership style, with a willingness to engage directly in difficult problems and take responsibility for outcomes.
  • Strong organizational leadership and financial stewardship skills, with experience managing complex initiatives, teams, and budgets.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.
  • Deep commitment to Mercy For Animals' mission and values, and a determination to reduce suffering and end factory farming.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading corporate advocacy or accountability efforts across multiple countries or regions.
  • Experience working within the global farmed animal protection movement and collaborating with international advocacy coalitions.
  • Experience developing or implementing measurable impact frameworks and managing grant-funded programs.
  • Experience with strategic portfolio management, including using evidence to guide resource decisions, impact evaluation, or data analysis.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this role is $130,720 to $150,800 USD, with the final offer determined by the candidate's quailifications, relevant experience, and skills. In addition to a collaborative and innovative work environment, you will be able to take part in our benefits package, including no- or low-cost health, vision, and dental insurance; generous paid time off and sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan with a dollar-to-dollar employer match of up to 3.5% of your annual earnings.

For candidates applying outside of the United States, the regional salary range and benefits packages will be discussed during the initial interview stage.

Application Details

We consider traditional and nontraditional qualifications and carefully review each application, resume, and cover letter. Feel encouraged to go outside a traditional cover letter and state how you would add to our culture; what we would gain from having you on our team; and how you align with our organizational vision, mission, and values.

Our Commitment to You

Mercy For Animals is a globally minded organization. We are committed to the principles of equity and justice, and our culture celebrates authenticity—enabling every team member to shine. All employment decisions are based solely on individual qualifications, job needs, and job requirements, and potential team members of every color, orientation, age, gender, origin, veteran status, and ability are encouraged to apply. We strive to include candidates from historically marginalized communities and those from or in communities impacted by environmental, social, and economic injustice.

Come as you are, and help us transform society and construct a truly compassionate food system.

If you are Brazilian: Mercy For Animals will process your personal data for the purposes of conducting this recruitment process, based on Article 7, V of Law No. 13,709/2018 (Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD), which authorizes the processing of personal data for the performance of preliminary procedures related to a contract. For more information about how your data will be processed, stored, and shared, please refer to our Privacy Policy. BY SUBMITTING YOUR APPLICATION, YOU ACKNOWLEDGE THAT YOU HAVE READ AND ACCEPT THE TERMS OF OUR PRIVACY POLICY.

By submitting your information, you are indicating that you have read ourPrivacy Policy and accept its terms.

React Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: React Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 5+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced React Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern enterprise web applications that power customer-facing digital platforms, internal business portals, and cloud-native SaaS solutions. This role focuses on building highly responsive, scalable, and maintainable Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React while integrating seamlessly with enterprise APIs, cloud services, and microservices-based backend platforms.
You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, cloud architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers to deliver exceptional user experiences across large-scale enterprise applications. The ideal candidate combines deep React expertise with strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills, a passion for clean architecture, and experience building production applications that serve thousands of concurrent users.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade Single Page Applications (SPAs) using React and TypeScript.
  • Build reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components following enterprise design system standards.
  • Develop responsive web applications optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
  • Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, and cloud-native backend platforms.
  • Collaborate with UX designers to convert Figma or Adobe XD designs into pixel-perfect, accessible user interfaces.
  • Implement efficient client-side state management using Redux Toolkit, React Query, Zustand, or Context API.
  • Optimize application performance through lazy loading, code splitting, memoization, virtualization, and efficient rendering strategies.
  • Build secure authentication and authorization workflows using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Azure Active Directory, Okta, or Auth0.
  • Implement real-time features using WebSockets, SignalR, or Server-Sent Events (SSE).
  • Develop reusable custom hooks, utility libraries, and shared component packages.
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure application reliability and maintainability.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, and Agile ceremonies.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, browser compatibility challenges, and front-end performance bottlenecks.
  • Work closely with DevOps teams to automate deployments through CI/CD pipelines.

Required Skills
  • Five or more years of professional front-end software development experience.
  • Four or more years of hands-on React development experience building enterprise applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React 18+, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of React Hooks, Functional Components, Context API, Suspense, Error Boundaries, and component lifecycle.
  • Experience implementing state management using Redux Toolkit, Redux, Zustand, React Query (TanStack Query), or Context API.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL services.
  • Experience working with authentication technologies including JWT, OAuth2, Azure AD, Okta, Auth0, or OpenID Connect.
  • Strong understanding of responsive web design, accessibility (WCAG), semantic HTML, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with modern front-end build tools including Vite, Webpack, Babel, npm, and Yarn.
  • Experience working with Git, GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience using CI/CD platforms including GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
  • Strong debugging and performance optimization skills using Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, and browser profiling tools.
  • Experience consuming backend services built with .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, Node.js, or Python.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum development environments.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building enterprise SaaS platforms supporting thousands of concurrent users.
  • Familiarity with Next.js, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR).
  • Experience implementing Micro Frontend architecture using Module Federation.
  • Knowledge of Progressive Web Applications (PWA) and offline-first web applications.
  • Experience integrating real-time communication using SignalR, WebSockets, or Firebase.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
  • Familiarity with OpenAPI (Swagger), GraphQL, Apollo Client, and API Gateway integrations.
  • Experience developing reusable enterprise component libraries and design systems.
  • Exposure to OpenTelemetry, application monitoring, and front-end observability tools.

Project Environment
You will be joining a digital engineering team responsible for modernizing enterprise applications and delivering cloud-native customer experiences. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise customer self-service portals
  • Financial services dashboards and transaction platforms
  • Healthcare provider and patient engagement applications
  • Insurance policy management and claims processing systems
  • Real-time operational analytics and executive dashboards
  • Enterprise workflow automation and document management platforms
  • Cloud-native microservices hosted on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Amazon EKS
  • Secure identity and access management solutions integrated with enterprise APIs
This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to front-end architecture, UI development, API integration, testing, performance optimization, cloud deployments, and continuous enhancement of mission-critical enterprise applications.

About Beazley Security

Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

3-6 Month Contract

The CyberServices Operations Project Manager is responsible for driving the successful planning, execution, governance, and operational coordination of key internal projects, including the onboarding of an outsourced service to triage customer service tickets & the co-ordination of process changes and efficiency improvements in Cyber Services’ ticketing platform - Zendesk. Solution Engineer Power Systems

Smart Grid Technology

Remote USA

Are you passionate about addressing the most pressing technical challenges facing the US grid, from low inertia and oscillations to large-scale renewable integration and NERC reliability requirements?

Do you thrive at the intersection of engineering expertise, customer collaboration, and real-world impact? If so, this could be your next big move.

The Company A Global Leader in Grid Innovation

Our client is reshaping how grids are planned and operated across North America and beyond. Their mission: deliver stable, resilient, low-carbon power systems that enable utilities and operators to meet Net Zero goals while maintaining compliance with stringent US reliability and interconnection standards.

With advanced analytics and dynamic stability solutions, including oscillation detection, PMU/WAMS-based monitoring, and inertia management, they are at the forefront of grid modernization.

The Role Solution Engineer (Power Systems)

As a Solution Engineer, youll work closely with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and grid operators across the US, applying advanced simulations and monitoring tools to help them solve stability and compliance challenges.

This is an ideal role for an engineer ready to step into a customer-facing, solution-driven position, with a clear career pathway toward senior technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Engagement: Partner with utilities, ISOs, and transmission operators to align solutions with technical and regulatory requirements.
  • Dynamic Stability Expertise: Deliver presentations and demonstrations showing how to address oscillations, ROCOF, reduced inertia, and weak-grid issues.
  • PMU/WAMS Analytics: Showcase how wide-area monitoring data can support compliance, oscillation detection, and real-time situational awareness.
  • Policy & Standards Alignment: Translate NERC, FERC, and ISO-specific requirements into technical solutions that meet customer and regulatory needs.
  • Proposal & Bid Support: Contribute to proposals and bids, ensuring technical content highlights compliance and reliability value.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with product, sales, and engineering to co-design tailored solutions.
  • Innovation Translation: Identify customer challenges and feed back into product strategy for new features and capabilities.

Experience & Skills

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or related field.
  • Knowledge of US reliability standards (NERC, FERC, ISO/RTO interconnection requirements).
  • Strong understanding of dynamic stability challenges: oscillations, low inertia, inter-area modes, and renewable integration.
  • Experience with simulation tools such as PSS®E, PSCAD, or PowerFactory.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to present complex concepts to both engineers and executives.
  • Proactive and ambitious with the drive to grow into a Technical Lead role.
  • Experience with synchrophasor (PMU) data and oscillation detection methods.
  • Familiarity with ISO/RTO operations (e.g., CAISO, ERCOT, PJM, MISO, NYISO).
  • Exposure to compliance studies, grid codes, and interconnection processes.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive base salary (DOE & qualifications)
  • Annual performance-related bonus
  • 401k Scheme
  • Medical cover
  • Enhanced holiday allowance
  • Training budget for professional development
  • Collaborative working environment
  • Charity days
  • Home working allowance

Whats Next?

If you're ready to bring your power systems expertise and regulatory knowledge to a role where you'll directly shape the stability and compliance of the future US grid, we'd love to hear from you

.

Please apply with your CV, or reach out directly to Daniel Salway at CleanTech Talent for a confidential discussion.

CleanTech Talent is acting as an exclusive hiring partner for this role.
