raw.description:
About Everist

Everist is redefining the future of hair and body care with concentrated, high-performance formulations and a strong commitment to sustainability. We are a brand built on innovation, storytelling, and community, and we’re entering our next phase of growth.

We're looking for a creative, hands-on Creative & Content Coordinator to bring the Everist brand to life across every channel — from our social feeds to our paid ads to the copy that makes people stop scrolling.

The Role

This is a creative execution role for someone who can do it all — shoot it, write it, edit it, and post it. You'll own Everist's content output across organic social and paid channels, while also taking on broader creative projects including copywriting, campaign assets, and brand storytelling.

You're as comfortable behind a camera as you are writing a caption or briefing a designer. You understand what makes content perform in beauty and wellness, and you have the creative range to work across formats, platforms, and audiences.

What You'll Own

Content Creation

  • Concept, create, and produce original content for Instagram, TikTok, and other owned channels — including photo, video, Reels, and short-form video.

  • Shoot and edit content independently (on iPhone or camera), as well as direct creators, photographers, videographers or video editors as needed.

  • Develop a strong, consistent visual and tonal identity across all content that reflects Everist's "Beauty, Undiluted" positioning.

  • Build and manage a content calendar that balances brand storytelling, product moments, cultural hooks, and community content.

Paid Ad Creative

  • Oversee and manage creative for paid social campaigns across Meta and TikTok, working closely with the growth team to develop and iterate on high-performing ad concepts.

  • Develop briefs for paid creative and produce assets that are optimized for performance without sacrificing brand integrity.

  • Analyze creative performance data to identify what's working and bring fresh concepts to the testing roadmap regularly.

Social Media Management

  • Own day-to-day social media management across Instagram and TikTok — posting, scheduling, community engagement, and trend monitoring.

  • Stay deeply plugged into platform trends, algorithm changes, and creator culture to keep Everist's content fresh and relevant.

  • Identify and engage with user-generated content and community moments that can be amplified across owned channels.

  • Maintain a pulse on the beauty and wellness industry — following brands, founders, editors, and creators to bring culturally relevant ideas and inspiration to the team.

Copywriting & Brand Voice

  • Write compelling copy across formats — social captions, ad copy, email subject lines, product descriptions, website copy, and campaign messaging — in a voice that feels distinctly Everist.

  • Maintain and evolve Everist's brand voice guidelines, ensuring consistency across all written touchpoints.

  • Support broader creative projects including campaign concepting, launch messaging, and brand storytelling initiatives.

Who You Are

  • 1-3 years of experience in content creation, social media, or a creative role — ideally at a DTC, eCommerce, or CPG brand (beauty or wellness is a strong plus).

  • Have a background in or deep passion for the beauty industry, with an unconventional creative perspective and a genuine connection to what Everist stands for.

  • A strong content creator who can shoot and edit video and photo independently, with a polished, on-brand aesthetic.

  • Excellent copywriter with the ability to adapt tone and format across platforms while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

  • Hands-on experience managing organic social across Instagram and TikTok, including community management and scheduling.

  • Familiar with paid social creative — you understand what makes an ad perform and can develop assets with performance in mind.

  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously without losing quality or missing deadlines.

raw.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Prenuvo is seeking a detail-oriented Staff Accountant – AP & Corporate Accounting to support month-end close and our high-volume AP environment. The role independently owns assigned routine accounting activities, including reconciliations, journal entries, accruals and supporting schedules; investigates discrepancies; supports AP cutoff and completeness; and provides accounting support across corporate cards, reimbursements, Bill Pay and evolving Procure-to-Pay workflows.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

  • Prepare and reconcile assigned routine balance-sheet, AP and general-ledger accounts accurately and within established month-end deadlines.
  • Investigate reconciling items and accounting discrepancies, resolve items within the role's scope and appropriately escalate unusual or judgmental matters.
  • Prepare routine journal entries, accruals, reclassifications and supporting schedules.
  • Support AP cutoff, completeness and period-end review, including investigation of outstanding or unusual items.
  • Review assigned vendor, corporate-card and reimbursement activity for appropriate accounting treatment, coding and entity allocation where accounting review is required.
  • Support accounting for Ramp corporate cards, reimbursements and Bill Pay and partner with the AP Specialist on operational exceptions.
  • Prepare routine account analysis, variance explanations and audit-ready schedules as assigned.
  • Support external audit requests and maintain organized accounting documentation.
  • Support PO/P2P accounting activities such as coding, entity selection, invoice/PO discrepancies, accrual inputs and period-end treatment.
  • Maintain assigned SOPs and identify practical opportunities to improve reconciliation quality, accounting accuracy and close efficiency.
  • Collaborate effectively with AP, Corporate Accounting, FP&A and business stakeholders in a distributed working environment.

What You’ll Bring

  • Post-secondary degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
  • 2–4 years of progressive accounting experience; candidates with equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
  • Hands-on experience with month-end close activities, account reconciliations, journal entries, accruals and supporting schedules.
  • Working knowledge of accounting principles and financial controls.
  • Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization and follow-through.
  • Ability to independently manage assigned routine accounting responsibilities and meet close deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and ability to collaborate effectively in a remote/distributed team.
  • NetSuite or comparable ERP experience.
  • Ramp or comparable corporate-card, expense-management or P2P platform experience.
  • Multi-entity and/or multi-currency accounting exposure.
  • High-volume AP or expense-accounting experience.
  • Purchase Order, procurement or P2P workflow exposure.
  • Experience supporting audits, Finance systems or process improvements.
  • Healthcare, technology, high-growth or multi-location company experience.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventive healthcare for everyone. This role includes whole-body scans as part of our employee benefits
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • Prenuvo offers eligible Canadian employees access to both RRSP and TFSA retirement savings plans, with immediate, optional enrollment and the flexibility to invest and save for the future on your own terms. While Prenuvo provides access to these plans, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $70,000-$82,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to .

raw.description:
About Karius

Karius is a life science, venture-backed clinical metagenomics company, focused on elevating patient care through microbial insights. We are committed to advancing diagnostic science and technology to optimize the diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases. Through the use of genomics and AI, we are driven to improve the diagnostic landscape for infectious diseases. Karius delivers unprecedented diagnostic insight detecting microbial cell-free DNA circulating in the body to assist physicians to make rapid treatment decisions.

Position Summary

This represents an incredible opportunity to join a growing life sciences company poised to revolutionize the Infectious Disease diagnostics market. We are expanding the launch of our proprietary, Next-Generation Sequencing test in hospitals and health systems across the U.S. Joining Karius in our commercialization effort will both accelerate your career and advance our vision to see a world where infectious disease is no longer a major threat to human health. The Clinical Sales Manager is responsible for the sales efforts of Karius in a defined regional territory, focusing on relationships with infectious disease physicians, lab directors, C-level executives, and other clinical leaders throughout a hospital system.

Why Should You Join Us?

Karius aims to conquer infectious diseases through innovations around genomic sequencing and machine learning. The company’s platform is already delivering unprecedented insights into the microbial landscape, providing clinicians with a comprehensive test capable of identifying more than a thousand pathogens directly from blood, and helping industry accelerate the development of therapeutic solutions. The Karius test we provide today is one of the most advanced solutions available to physicians who aim to deliver better care to many otherwise ineffectively treated patients. Our test is the result of some incredible work done by our scientists, statisticians, engineers, and physicians, all driven by the same mission. You, as part of the Karius team, will be able to see how directly your work has a life-changing impact on people, and at scale.
Reports to: Regional Sales Director
Territory: Alabama (Gulf Coast) with deep knowledge and experience in the greater metropolitan area health systems.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Grow sales revenue and test volume in territory by establishing new business in hospitals while increasing volume in existing hospitals. Introduce a transformational, life-saving diagnostic technology which will change the world of infectious disease by engaging key stakeholders in the hospital that are involved with the decision process to implement new diagnostic tests.
  • Collaboration with Inside Sales, Customer Success, Medical Affairs, and Marketing to achieve territory and company goals.
  • Develop thought leaders and early adopters for this new approach to infectious disease diagnosis.
  • Help establish the foundation and culture of a world-class commercial organization.
  • Build, manage and nurture market-based/regional territory, comprising hospital & health system accounts.
  • Prioritize and segment hospital & health system accounts to maximize opportunity and growth.
  • Present product features and benefits to key stakeholders and clinical call points, utilizing consultative sales techniques (qualifying leads, assessing needs, supporting evaluations, and closing). Manage early evaluations to activate initial adoption of Karius test/solutions and drive increased utilization over time.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert, speaking with clinicians of all levels regarding the science and technology of the Karius test and how to best leverage its capabilities. Speak fluently on the unique merits and value of our proprietary test, positioning our differentiation from the competition.
  • Build deep relationships, educate and drive consensus across multiple stakeholders among both prospective and existing partners.
  • Develop a ‘trusted advisor’ relationship and establish oneself as fully accountable for demonstrating ROI to the partner account, ensuring both regular interaction and utilization review.
  • Secure contracts and agreements, where necessary or optimal, to memorialize long-term relationships with partners, define an exchange of value, and augment predictability into revenue.
  • Manage and secure renewals of partner agreements.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Product leadership to provide valuable market feedback, to inform all functions.
  • Partner, and co-present, with Karius’ Clinical/Medical Affairs teams (including Medical Science Liaisons) to support partner interactions, both remote and in-person, and manage follow-up.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to onboard new accounts, share feedback, proactively address risks, immediately address concerns/problems, manage expectations, promote successes, and maintain close pulse on the health of the partner.
  • Partner with Marketing to identify and co-manage regional meeting opportunities, develop Key Opinion Leader (KOL) panels, and other local market activities.
  • Participate in broader sales meetings, training programs, conventions, and industry trade shows as required.
  • Complete paperwork and administrative duties in a timely and accurate fashion, including documentation in SalesForce, expense reporting, speaker program information, etc.

What’s Fun About the Job?

Karius is operating at the edge of what is now known to be possible in infectious disease diagnostics. With that, comes a wave of new and incredible challenges and opportunities. To deliver on that value, you will be tapping into some of the most advanced technologies, architecting and innovating where the current solutions simply don't suffice. You will get to see how much your work really matters.
Travel: Up to 70%.

Physical Requirements

Subject to extended periods of sitting and/or standing, vision to monitor and moderate noise levels. Work is generally performed remotely in the field.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree; advanced degree or MBA a plus.
  • 5 years of sales/business development experience in Life Sciences / Biotech, Medical Device, Diagnostic Equipment, and/or Pharmaceutical industries.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Previous success in introducing transformational, novel products or services to physicians and hospitals which have changed clinical practice prior to significant peer-reviewed publications or inclusion in guidelines for support.
  • Robust network of existing relationships in hospitals and health systems, across microbiology labs, send-out labs, physician groups, C-level executives, and administrators of clinical functions.
  • Strong vision and planning capabilities to grow the territory.
  • Excellent business acumen combined with outstanding analytical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong ability to develop relationships from C-level executives to physicians and lab directors, building credibility through subject matter and industry expertise.
  • Demonstrated track record of top sales achievement, meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Experience with multi-level account management.

Personal Qualifications

  • Entrepreneurial spirit and is comfortable multitasking and working in a fast-paced, ambiguous, growth-oriented environment.
  • Team player willing to collaborate with all customer facing teams to share best practices.
  • Ability to set priorities, allocate resources, take accountability and achieve results.
  • Strong presentation acumen and negotiation skills, ability to manage and facilitate engaging discussions with both small and large groups.
  • Unquestionable personal code of ethics, integrity, confidentiality and ability to build trusting and professional relationships.
  • Passionate about the mission and reputation of Karius while investing in the culture as the company grows.

Disclaimer

The above job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. raw.description:
Job Summary:

As General Manager, Small & Medium Business (SMB), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s SMB business, with full P&L and budget authority. You will improve how we win new clients, retain and expand existing relationships, and bring more of Toptal’s capabilities to market. You will decide where to invest, build the team, and be accountable for the results.

SMB requires consistent and strong commercial judgment at a high volume. New clients arrive with an immediate need; within 15 minutes your team must quickly understand the problem, explain how Toptal can help, and move the opportunity toward a sale. In addition to strengthening the inbound execution, you will grow our nascent outbound sales motion, improve our client expansion motion, develop more targeted marketing with our Enterprise industry teams, and activate a partnership ecosystem to bring new clients and revenue to Toptal.

You will lead a high-energy sales organization with clear expectations and rigorous performance management. You will listen to calls, speak with clients, examine where opportunities are lost, and coach your leaders through specific performance issues. You will know whether a shortfall comes from demand, selling quality, pricing, capacity, or the client experience, and act with the responsible teams to address it. Your managers should see the standard you expect in your own work.

You will build on an established client base and inbound demand to expand the problems small and medium-sized businesses trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Set and execute the SMB strategy. Identify the client needs, offerings, and sales approaches with the strongest growth potential. Build a business plan with clear financial objectives, priorities, and investment choices. Strengthen the existing talent business while developing additional sources of growth.
  • Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Understand how conversion, retention, pricing, offering mix, and the cost to acquire and serve clients affect results. Allocate resources, evaluate returns, and act when performance diverges from the plan.
  • Improve conversion from first contact to first engagement. Set clear standards for response speed, discovery, qualification, and closing. Ensure sellers maintain ownership as specialists resolve technical questions and clients move through the buying process. Find where momentum is lost and address the underlying causes.
  • Grow and retain the client base. Build an account management approach that gives clients appropriate attention based on their needs and potential. Expect proactive conversations about upcoming work, engagement outcomes, and opportunities to do more with Toptal. Address reasons clients leave and develop practical ways to earn repeat business.
  • Build outbound sales and targeted marketing. Grow the nascent outbound motion into a repeatable source of revenue. Work with Marketing, Sales Development, and Enterprise industry teams to select target clients, develop relevant propositions, and run coordinated campaigns. Use shared industry insight and client experience to sharpen targeting, then assess results through conversion, revenue, and acquisition economics.
  • Activate a partnership ecosystem. Build partnerships that create qualified demand and new revenue for SMB. Identify and recruit the right partners, equip them to sell with Toptal, and develop joint plans with clear opportunity ownership. Turn promising relationships into active referral, co-selling, or resale motions, and invest in those that produce profitable growth.
  • Expand adoption of services and AI-based solutions. Help sellers recognize when a client’s needs extend beyond an individual talent request. Work with Services leaders and specialists to develop relevant propositions, bring expertise into client conversations, and close business. Build the team’s ability to sell broader solutions while maintaining progress on the client’s immediate need.
  • Build a high-performing sales organization. Recruit strong managers and sellers, set demanding but achievable expectations, and establish a daily and weekly rhythm for performance management. Hold managers accountable for call quality, conversion, productivity, and commercial results. Review their coaching, demonstrate stronger approaches, recognize strong performance, and address underperformance promptly.
  • Match capacity and coverage to the work. Plan staffing around demand, response expectations, active opportunities, and account needs. Give teams clear ownership and workable client portfolios. Coordinate with Operations, Matching, and Delivery so internal transitions preserve context and keep clients moving forward.
  • Run the business with reliable evidence. Establish a consistent view of acquisition, engagement starts, retention, expansion, seller productivity, and financial performance. Build forecasts that reflect the speed and volume of SMB sales. Test changes against clear baselines, distinguish temporary movement from sustained improvement, and use technology and AI to improve execution.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, SMB sales process, and client value proposition.
  • Meet your leadership team and the functions supporting acquisition, account management, partnerships, matching, and delivery.
  • Listen to client calls and begin reviewing the funnel, client portfolio, P&L, budget, and team performance, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop an informed view of where SMB wins, where clients lose momentum, and what limits growth.
  • Assess your leaders and teams, including coaching, performance, capacity, and hiring priorities.
  • Establish a consistent rhythm for commercial reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching.
  • Present your proposed SMB business plan, including priority outbound campaigns, partnership opportunities, financial assumptions, and investment choices.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, and ownership.
  • Have implemented initial improvements to conversion and retention, with baselines and a clear way to assess their impact.
  • Be running targeted outbound campaigns with Marketing, Sales Development, and Enterprise industry teams, and activating initial partner opportunities.
  • Have made the initial talent and leadership decisions needed to strengthen execution.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable progress against the plan in revenue, profitability, conversion, and retention.
  • Show that coaching and consistent performance management are improving seller and manager effectiveness.
  • Show early commercial results from outbound campaigns and activated partners, with evidence to guide further investment.
  • Manage the P&L against the budget and address material variances with specific actions.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver against the agreed SMB revenue, profitability, and budget objectives.
  • Have built a stronger leadership team with clear accountability, effective coaching, and consistent execution.
  • Demonstrate sustained improvement in acquiring, retaining, and growing clients, including broader adoption of Toptal’s capabilities.
  • Have established outbound sales and partnerships as measurable contributors to growth, with a clear plan for scaling them.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. An MBA or a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or mathematics is preferred.
  • 12+ years of B2B commercial experience, including SaaS or services sales, with a sustained record of scaling high-volume sales to small and medium-sized businesses. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to growth and improved commercial performance.
  • 5+ years leading sales and account management teams, including experience managing managers. You have built high-energy teams, set clear performance standards, improved results through specific coaching, addressed underperformance, and developed future leaders.
  • Experience leading both new-client acquisition and account management, with evidence of improving conversion, retention, and expansion.
  • Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, staffing, investment, and client coverage affected revenue and profitability.
  • Experience building outbound sales and working with Marketing and Sales Development on targeted campaigns that produce measurable revenue.
  • Experience activating commercial partnerships and turning partner relationships into qualified opportunities and revenue.
  • Strong analytical judgment. You can trace a performance problem through the sales process, test competing explanations, and determine whether a change produced a meaningful improvement.
  • The ability to improve a high-volume sales operation while introducing new offerings or ways of selling. You can make changes without losing control of daily execution.
  • Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently, evaluate commercial opportunities, and recognize when specialist expertise is needed.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can explain the business, make a compelling investment case, and give teams specific direction.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including proposals and presentations.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
  • Travel as needed to develop client and partner relationships and work with your team.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

raw.description:
Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space? Our client, Tucketts, an innovative US-based socks and foot care brand, is looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to join its team and lead strategic initiatives that will elevate the brand to new heights. This is a fully remote, full-time role.

This role will focus on creating and executing growth strategies across multiple channels, improving the customer journey, and maximizing our brand presence on social media, email, and other key platforms. If you have a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape, particularly with Shopify, and are data-driven, collaborative, and proactive, with a track record of achieving growth in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, please read on!

About the Company:

Tucketts is a rapidly growing e-commerce brand with a strong presence in the Shopify ecosystem and on Amazon. This women-owned company is dedicated to promoting foot health and wellness through a unique range of socks and foot care products. Tucketts mission is to empower individuals to prioritize their foot health while making a positive social impact through ethical manufacturing practices. The company prioritizes sustainability by creating eco-friendly products and supporting fair labor practices, ensuring a balance between people, profit, and the planet. Tucketts employs women in Colombia, supporting their economic empowerment, and contributes to educational initiatives for girls in the Maasai community in Tanzania, inspired by the founders journey up Mount Kilimanjaro.

Your Goals in This Role:

  • Leverage our customer base to boost sales and expand our social media reach.
  • Develop our Shopify brand through targeted e-commerce promotions, email marketing and digital campaigns
  • Double our sales and customer base.
  • Analyze performance data to continually improve ad spend efficiency and ROI.
  • Enhance our social media presence by growing our TikTok following and engaging with our Instagram influencers, followers, and email list.
  • Manage current team and hire new members according to the company's needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Devise and implement strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets and customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, SEO, and PPC, to drive traffic and increase conversions.
  • Continuously analyze and optimize the website for user experience, performance, and conversion rates, implementing A/B testing and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Optimize our social media channels and influencers to amplify brand messaging and drive conversions.
  • Execute compelling e-commerce promotions that resonate with our target audience.
  • Develop and execute effective email marketing campaigns to nurture customer relationships and drive repeat purchases.
  • Manage and optimize advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Tucketts online store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers.
  • Monitor and analyze eCommerce performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement to achieve sales targets. Use data-driven approaches to make strategic decisions.
  • Find and collaborate with influencers to become brand ambassadors

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a growth marketing or digital marketing role, within e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and strategies (SEO, PPC, etc).
  • Proficiency in Shopify, email marketing and social media platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform marketing strategies.
  • Creativity and innovation in developing engaging marketing campaigns.
  • Knowledge of Amazon specifics is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable with implementing automation tools and exploring AI to improve efficiency.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • A strong desire to grow a company and demonstrate skills that lead to measurable impact.

What We Offer:

  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.

If you're a growth-focused marketer with a passion for e-commerce and a knack for driving customer engagement, wed love to hear from you!

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Junior E-Maintenance Planner / Scheduler to support maintenance planning and operational coordination for a U.S.-based client.

In this role, you will assist with planning preventive and corrective maintenance activities, managing work orders, coordinating schedules, and ensuring that maintenance tasks are completed efficiently and on time.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior professional who is eager to develop their technical and operational skills while working with an international team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and schedule preventive and corrective maintenance activities across mechanical, electrical, and general maintenance operations.

  • Create, update, and track maintenance work orders using Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

  • Coordinate maintenance schedules with operations and maintenance teams to minimize equipment downtime and operational disruptions.

  • Support resource planning, including labor, equipment, materials, and spare parts.

  • Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure required materials are available when needed.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of maintenance activities, inspections, repairs, and work order status.

  • Assist with basic maintenance cost estimates and cost tracking.

  • Use Microsoft Excel and scheduling tools to organize information, track progress, and maintain operational records.

  • Monitor maintenance schedules and proactively communicate changes, delays, or issues to relevant stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support efficient maintenance operations.

What We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in maintenance planning, scheduling, work order management, facilities support, or operational coordination. Relevant internships and transferable experience may also be considered.

  • English proficiency at B2+ level or higher, with strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including data organization, sorting, filtering, and basic formulas.

  • Foundational understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance processes.

  • Familiarity with CMMS tools or similar scheduling and work order management systems.

  • Basic knowledge of resource coordination, inventory tracking, and maintenance documentation.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

  • Proactive communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

  • Willingness to learn new tools, processes, and maintenance management systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using CMMS platforms such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo, eMaint, Fiix, or similar tools.

  • Exposure to industrial maintenance, manufacturing, facilities management, or related operations.

  • Experience coordinating spare parts, inventory, or procurement requests.

  • Basic knowledge of maintenance cost estimation and operational reporting.

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based teams.

Working Conditions

  • Location: 100% Remote – Latin America.

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT).

  • Employment Type: Full-time.

  • Engagement: Long-term opportunity.

  • English Level: B2+ to C1.

Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely from Latin America with an international team.

  • Gain hands-on experience supporting U.S.-based operations.

  • Develop your maintenance planning, scheduling, and operational coordination skills.

  • Collaborate with experienced professionals in a supportive environment.

  • Grow your career through a long-term professional opportunity.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

If you're organized, proactive, comfortable working with Excel, and interested in growing your career in maintenance planning and scheduling, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply today and take the next step in your professional journey!

raw.description:
Position Summary

NV5 is a leading provider of compliance, technology, and engineering consulting solutions. As part of the Technology & Acoustics group, services include planning and design in a wide range of specialty areas including audiovisual, IT/telecommunications, building security, lighting, healthcare technologies, and architectural acoustics/noise vibration.

We play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide and are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team.

The Acoustical Consultant will act as a team member in NV5’s architectural acoustics practice. That team is a close-knit group of dynamic, hard-working, and well-qualified acousticians who seek to deliver best-in-class solutions to our clients using state-of-the-art tools, a healthy appetite for technical exploration, and a commitment to excellent client communications.

The position will require the candidate to act as the primary acoustical consultant on a variety of national and regional projects including classrooms, lecture halls, healthcare facilities, courthouses, conference centers, resort/casinos, theatres, media production facilities, and broadcast studios. The consultant must develop, present, and manage solutions related to room acoustics, sound isolation, mechanical system noise and vibration control, and environmental acoustics. As necessary, the consultant will create drawings, prepare reports, use acoustic modeling software, and perform on-site acoustic testing to support their design work. The position requires the candidate to actively participate in several concurrent projects while efficiently delivering accurate, thorough, and high-quality work to our clients.

This position is U.S.-based, and Work From Home. We are open to major U.S. markets other than those listed.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the project design team, bringing a creative, collaborative, evidence-based approach to architectural acoustics
  • Collaborate with architectural team members and clients
  • Develop high-quality architectural acoustics reports, sketches, drawings, details, cost analyses, and specification documents
  • Analyze acoustic solutions using computer modeling software
  • Review submittals and shop drawings
  • Perform on-site acoustics testing and noise surveys
  • Perform on-site inspections to review the implementation of a project’s acoustical solutions
  • Coordinate with the firm Principals and marketing staff with business development activities, including sales meetings, short-list interviews and proposals
  • Attend project meetings, site visits, and perform on-site acoustic testing
  • Ensure that all work is completed on-time, in-budget, and consistently within NV5’s high standards of quality
  • Perform additional duties as assigned

Requirements

  • 5 – 10 years’ experience as a consultant in architectural acoustics
  • Bachelor’s degree in acoustics, audio/music engineering, mechanical engineering, architectural engineering, or physics including relevant classes or a degree concentration in acoustics or vibration is required. Master’s degree preferred.
  • INCE Board Certification preferred
  • Expertise in a broad range of acoustical disciplines, including room acoustics, sound isolation, mechanical system noise and vibration control, and environmental acoustics
  • A healthy appetite for technical exploration and professional development
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Outstanding oral and written communication skills
  • Values that include integrity, responsibility, and accountability
  • Works equally well as an individual contributor or team member
  • Maintains a professional and positive attitude in a fast paced and occasionally high-pressure environment
  • Experience in business development for professional services, with a focus on Acoustics, is a plus
  • Expertise in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel & Outlook
  • Experience with Revit / BIM, AutoCAD, BlueBeam, Sketch-Up, Ease, and CadnaA desirable but not required
  • LEED certification is desirable but not required

All candidates must be driven to satisfy the needs of end users and have the ability to deliver high caliber results in a timely manner while operating without direct supervision. Some overnight travel may be required. On occasion, it may be necessary to participate in off-hours acoustic testing, as needed to support our design services.

The pay range for this California position is $90,000- $125,000 per year; however, base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience of the candidate. Restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. This information is provided per California Senate Bill 1162. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via the NV5 careers site.

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, creed, citizenship status, ancestry, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Benefits

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

  • Competitive Salary
  • Medical, dental, and supplemental insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Company paid Life & AD&D
  • Company paid Disability
  • 401K Plan
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Time Off

Company Overview

NV5 delivers technology-enabled engineering, consulting, and geospatial solutions that help clients plan, design, and optimize infrastructure, buildings, utilities, and environmental systems. We bring together technical expertise, data, and innovative thinking to create resilient, high-performance assets. As part of TiC Solutions, alongside Acuren, we share a purpose: to shape and strengthen the physical world.

Our work starts with our people. We invest in their growth and never compromise on safety. We work as one team across disciplines and geographies, bringing diverse perspectives and a shared purpose to complex challenges.

At NV5, we take pride in high-quality work that creates lasting value for our clients. We challenge the status quo, continuously improve, and turn insight into smarter designs, plans, and solutions. Join us to contribute your expertise and collaborate with our teams to help shape the infrastructure and systems the world relies on.

raw.description:
We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to own the full email execution cycle across campaign builds, automations, A/B testing, segmentation, and performance reporting inside Klaviyo for a data-first growth marketing agency serving a focused roster of e-commerce and DTC brands.

This is a hands-on execution role with real ownership of campaign performance. You will be in Klaviyo every day, building flows, running A/B tests, managing segmentation, and turning performance data into clear, client-ready reporting. This is not a strategy-from-a-distance role. If you are a detail-obsessed email marketer who thrives in a fast-paced agency environment and takes pride in clean, error-free deployments that actually move metrics, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work inside a data-first agency with a rigorous analytical culture and a focused, high-quality e-commerce client roster
  • High-ownership email execution role with direct impact on campaign performance across multiple client accounts

What You'll Work On

Campaign Building and Deployment

  • Build, test, QA, deploy, and monitor Klaviyo email and SMS campaigns including batch sends, behaviorally triggered messages, and automated lifecycle journeys
  • Schedule campaigns accurately across multiple client accounts and ensure nothing launches late or with incorrect assets
  • Configure dynamic content blocks and conditional logic within campaigns to improve relevance and personalization
  • Support creative and layout needs by selecting images, formatting text, and ensuring final output aligns with brand standards

Flow and Automation Management

  • Build and manage email flows and automations including triggers, conditions, content, and timing
  • Support and execute SMS sends within Klaviyo
  • Troubleshoot flow issues and ensure automations are running correctly across all client accounts
  • Document flow logic and changes clearly for full team visibility

Segmentation and List Management

  • Build targeted audience segments using Klaviyo filters, conditions, and custom attributes based on user behavior, lifecycle stage, and other attributes
  • Maintain list hygiene and segmentation across client email databases
  • Leverage segmentation to improve campaign relevance and performance

A/B Testing and Optimization

  • Set up and run A/B tests across campaigns and flows to continuously improve engagement and conversion metrics
  • Track and optimize email performance by proactively flagging trends at the campaign and journey level
  • Surface actionable insights to internal stakeholders and clients based on test results and performance data

Reporting and Client Communication

  • Deliver regular email performance reporting with historical comparisons, channel benchmarks, and recommendations
  • Create client-ready slides and presentations translating key metrics and learnings into simple charts and bullets
  • Maintain a clear understanding of key performance metrics including open rates, CTR, conversion rate, and deliverability and use them to guide optimization decisions

What You Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on email marketing execution experience, ideally in a fast-paced agency or DTC e-commerce environment
  • Deep expertise in Klaviyo for campaign setup, flow building, segmentation, and analytics
  • 2 or more years of experience working with Shopify
  • Demonstrated experience creating and launching A/B tests and reporting clearly on their impact
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills including data export, templates, basic formulas, and clean formatting
  • Comfortable turning performance data into simple, client-ready slides with charts and bullets
  • Strong understanding of segmentation and how to apply it to improve campaign performance
  • Detail-oriented with a proven ability to QA work thoroughly before every deployment
  • Fluent written and spoken English with the confidence to explain performance trends and next steps clearly

raw.description:
GPU & AI Infrastructure – Reserved Deal Desk Broker

Independent Contractor

PADO AI Orchestration, Inc., a new venture born out of LG Electronics and backed by LG NOVA, is revolutionizing energy management for the modern AI data center. We are on a mission to maximize Compute Per Megawatt™ by bridging the gap between infrastructure constraints and the explosive demand for AI-driven compute.

That mission has a commercial front door: PADO’s GPU marketplace. We broker compute between the neocloud and aggregator supply base and the AI-native companies that need capacity now — moving from on-demand and spot into the reserved market, where the real contracts get written. With LG’s backing in BESS storage, high-efficiency chillers, and liquid cooling, we bring credibility to the supply side that a broker alone does not have.

We are seeking a GPU & AI Infrastructure – Reserved Deal Desk Broker to run transactions across both sides of that marketplace. This is not an SDR seat and it is not account management. You will source supply, source demand, match them, price the spread, and carry the deal to signature. Our buyers are the ones the hyperscalers cannot serve — AI-native platforms, defense and robotics programs, biotech, and capital markets firms whose compliance requirements exclude standard hyperscaler options, and whose infrastructure decisions are made at the board level. If you have spent the last two years living in GPU pricing sheets and know who actually has inventory this quarter, this is a desk built for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Supply-Side Sourcing: Build and maintain a live supplier network across neoclouds, aggregators, marketplaces, and colocation-backed operators. Negotiate reserved capacity pricing, prepayment terms, and service levels across H100, H200, B200/B300, GB200/GB300, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, and AMD Instinct MI300X/MI355X.
  • Demand-Side Origination: Source and qualify AI-native buyers — inference platforms and foundation model developers, defense technology, robotics and simulation, biotech, and quantitative finance — and translate their workloads into a capacity specification a supplier can actually quote.
  • Transaction Matching: Match workload requirements — interconnect, bare-metal access, region, term length, memory and network profile — against available inventory. Know when a cluster genuinely fits a workload and when it does not.
  • Multi-Stakeholder Deal Navigation: Run procurement cycles that require simultaneous commercial alignment across engineering leaders, CFOs, founders, compliance officers, and board or investment stakeholders. Reserved commitments with significant upfront capital are decided at the board level, not by a single champion.
  • Spread and Margin Ownership: Price to a target spread and own the gross margin on every transaction you originate. You will be measured on realized margin, not on gross contract value.
  • Commercial Structuring: Negotiate prepayment and escrow mechanics, payment timing, SLA pass-through, and non-circumvention terms, including export control and cross-border deployment constraints. Work with PADO’s counsel to keep upstream and downstream agreements mirrored so risk does not sit with PADO.
  • Counterparty Diligence: Assess offtaker creditworthiness, supplier delivery risk, and concentration risk before any capacity is committed. Reserved capacity is a balance-sheet commitment, and the discipline not to commit it prematurely is part of the job.
  • Deal Registration and Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain high standards for Salesforce hygiene and provide accurate forecasting to the executive team. Deal registration governs both PADO’s exposure and your commission crediting.
  • Market Intelligence: Track spot and reserved pricing by chip, region, and term, and feed pricing signal back into PADO’s marketplace and product roadmap.
  • Industry Representation: Serve as a PADO brand ambassador at major trade shows and industry events.

Qualifications:

  • Live Network: 3+ years of full-cycle enterprise sales in GPU or compute brokering, neocloud sales, data center capacity sales, or infrastructure and commodity trading. Existing relationships on the supply side, the demand side, or both are the single most important qualification for this role.
  • Market Fluency: Current on GPU spot and reserved pricing, and fluent in what actually moves it — chip generation, interconnect, bare metal versus virtualized, region and power cost, term length, and prepayment structure.
  • Technical Literacy: Able to qualify a workload without an engineer in the room. You understand ML training environments and foundation model infrastructure, AI infrastructure failure modes, when multi-GPU sharding and NVLink matter and when they do not, and why a fast network without a shared filesystem can still be the wrong cluster.
  • Reserved Compute Planning: Comfortable structuring long-term commitments — one- to five-year terms carrying 25–50% upfront capital — alongside prepayment and escrow, SLA and service-credit regimes, and term-versus-price tradeoffs. You know the difference between GMV and margin, and you work the second one.
  • Regulated and Constrained Environments: Working knowledge of export controls, cross-border AI deployment, and data residency, and the requirements that follow from them — compute segregation for defense programs, auditable GPU cost structures for pre-IPO companies, and hardware-level isolation for proprietary model training in capital markets.
  • Commercial Judgment: You know when not to do a deal. Reserving inventory against unsigned demand is how brokers go out of business, and we expect you to hold that line even when a quarter is thin.
  • Sales Discipline: Rigorous qualification methodology (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or equivalent) and the ability to build account intelligence from live business signals, infrastructure decision triggers, and buyer-specific friction points.
  • AI-Augmented Professionalism: Beyond understanding AI/ML workloads and what they demand from infrastructure, you proactively use AI and go-to-market tooling — Salesforce, Clay, Apollo.io, Gong, and modern AI assistants — to streamline sourcing, automate counterparty research, and compress your own deal cycle.
  • Startup Resilience: Self-motivated and comfortable in a high-growth environment where you are expected to help build the “playbook,” not just run it.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent market experience. In this role, the network and the judgment matter more than the credential.

Why Join PADO?

  • The LG Advantage: Join a nimble, venture-backed startup that has the global scale and hardware engineering might of LG Electronics behind it. On the supply side, that name opens doors a standalone broker cannot.
  • A Live Marketplace: PADO’s marketplace is launching with real supplier inventory and a real demand pipeline through the LG ecosystem. You are not building a desk from an empty book.
  • Earning Potential: We believe in rewarding our deal makers. This role features a competitive monthly retainer plus commission, credited on the margin you actually realize and paid as PADO collects. Per-transaction caps apply.
  • Own the Desk: This is the first dedicated deal desk seat at PADO. You will define how the reserved book gets sourced, priced, and papered.
  • Supportive Culture: Collaborate with a team of experts in energy, AI, and data center operations who are passionate about the next industrial paradigm.

Engagement: Independent Contractor (1099)

Location: Remote

Travel: ~25% of time

Compensation: Monthly retainer, plus commission credited on realized gross margin.

Apply:

PADO AI Orchestration, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Position Summary

The Tier 2 Technician – Third Shift provides advanced technical support, maintenance, and monitoring for Company’s managed client environments during overnight hours. Responsibilities include responding to after-hours support requests, completing work best performed outside business hours, remediating failed updates and automated processes, monitoring backups and system health, and supporting scheduled maintenance and project work.

This role requires strong troubleshooting skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently. The technician keeps the team informed through clear documentation, escalation, and handoffs to the day shift.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Provide Tier 2 support for hardware, software, operating systems, applications, and basic network issues.
  • Respond to after-hours support requests and client tickets, including those under a dedicated support contract, prioritizing by urgency, business impact, and SLA requirements.
  • Perform software installations, OS and application updates, patching, server administration, and other scheduled maintenance. Monitor these processes and remediate failures when possible.
  • Monitor systems, alerts, and backups, and take corrective action or escalate as needed.
  • Complete assigned projects and tasks during overnight maintenance windows to minimize disruption to clients.
  • Escalate to Tier 3 or other team members when issues require additional expertise.
  • Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, system changes, and maintenance in the ticketing platform with enough detail for other staff to understand the work performed and any follow-up required.
  • Review outstanding issues from evening staff at the start of the shift, and provide a clear handoff to the day shift covering unresolved issues, completed maintenance, failed processes, and follow-up items.
  • Follow established security, change-management, escalation, and service-management procedures, and protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of client systems and data.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • 2–4 years of experience in IT support, desktop support, managed services, or a related field.
  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field preferred.
  • Tier 2 support or equivalent hands-on troubleshooting experience preferred.
  • MSP or multi-client environment experience preferred.
  • Overnight, on-call, or 24/7 operations experience preferred.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, and common business applications.
  • Experience troubleshooting software installations, Windows updates, patches, and failed automated processes.
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Experience with remote support and remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and structured IT service processes.
  • Backup monitoring and troubleshooting experience preferred.

Core Competencies

  • Resolves technical issues independently with limited direct supervision.
  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally, especially in documentation and shift handoffs.
  • Stays organized, detail-oriented, and productive during overnight hours.
  • Maintains a strong customer service focus.

Preferred Certifications

  • CompTIA Security+ or Network+
  • Microsoft certifications

Work Environment

  • Extended periods of computer and monitor use.
  • Weekend and holiday work may be required as part of service coverage.
  • Occasional daytime events may be required, with advance notice.
Salary: $24-$32 per hour

The role is well suited to someone who enjoys solving user problems, building and maintaining workflows, managing CRM data, and keeping sales and marketing processes running smoothly. You will work closely with users across a busy environment, taking ownership of routine platform administration while developing deeper expertise across Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, reporting, integrations, and automation.

  • Good problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate platform issues methodically.
  • Clear communication skills and a service-focused approach when supporting non-technical users.

HubSpot certifications in Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, CRM, or Revenue Operations are advantageous but not essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, test, maintain, and troubleshoot HubSpot workflows supporting sales, marketing, and enrolment-related processes.
  • Create, update, and maintain custom properties across contacts, companies, and deals while following appropriate data governance practices.

  • Investigate workflow errors, failed automations, and unexpected outcomes, documenting fixes and escalating more complex issues where appropriate.

Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.

Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.

About Claravine

Claravine is The Data Standards Company®. We help the world's largest brands and agencies deliver on the promise of modern marketing by standardizing taxonomies, naming conventions, and metadata across all digital experiences — at the source of data creation. That is why a quarter of the Fortune 100 trust The Data Standards Cloud™ to define, apply, and connect standards across their entire marketing ecosystem.

Our customers are enterprise marketing and analytics teams at global brands spending $50M+ per year on advertising. They depend on clean, consistent data to make decisions worth billions of dollars. When that data is wrong, their analytics are wrong, their AI models are wrong, and their investments are wasted. We fix that — at the source, before the chaos starts.

We are backed by growth equity investors and have built a track record with category-leading brands. Now we are looking for a marketing leader who can take the story we have earned with customers and make it impossible for the market to ignore.

The Opportunity

This is not a typical SVP of Marketing position. This is a category-building role, not a demand-gen-only seat. You'll build and lead the marketing function that defines a category, which means you'll be as much a thought leader and executive presence as an operator.

You will report directly to our CRO, sit at the executive table, be accountable for pipeline, revenue and market position, and do it with a lean, high-performing, AI-powered team and the credibility that comes from serving some of the most sophisticated marketing organizations in the world.

What You Will Own

Category Leadership & Strategic Narrative

  • Own Claravine's positioning as The Data Standards Company® and keep sharpening and expanding the category narrative
  • Be Claravine's voice on keynote stages, in industry publications, analyst briefings, executive panels and podcasts
  • Build and optimize competitive positioning that provides Sales and CS the language to win
  • Manage Gartner, Forrester, IDC and other analyst relationships so Claravine is included and positioned well in market research

Demand Generation & Pipeline

  • Own marketing's contribution to pipeline, with clear attribution, targets and accountability
  • Design and execute an enterprise ABM program targeting the Global 2000 accounts spending $50M+ on advertising
  • Drive demand through content, events, digital, partner co-marketing and direct outreach, focused on what converts at enterprise ACV
  • Elevate existing full-funnel reporting and attribution the board, CRO and CEO trust

Product Marketing

  • Lead messaging, positioning, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and launch strategy
  • Turn data standards and taxonomy management into business-value stories for CMO, VP Marketing and marketing analytics buyers
  • Develop pricing and packaging recommendations with product and finance
  • Build and maintain a new business sales and expansion enablement library that measurably improves win rates and ACV

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Run a content strategy that builds awareness, trust and inbound demand at every stage of the enterprise buyer journey
  • Commission and create authoritative research, benchmarks, and frameworks that make Claravine the definitive source on marketing data standards
  • Build customer advocacy: case studies, references, advisory boards and executive roundtables

Team & Operations

  • Build, lead and develop a team of 5-10 across product marketing, demand gen, content, xEO and contractors
  • Own the marketing budget and P&L, accountable for the ROI on every dollar spent
  • Use AI-powered workflows and tools to maximize the output of a lean team, then expand it
  • Set the reporting cadence and dashboards that keep marketing visible and trusted by the executive team

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 12+ years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing, with 4+ years in VP, SVP, or CMO roles leading the entire Marketing function
  • Proven success building category narrative and thought leadership at a company selling to enterprise marketing leaders (CMO, VP Marketing, marketing analytics, marketing technology)
  • Ownership of pipeline and revenue targets, with specific, quantified results you can point to
  • Experience running or closely supporting 6-12 month enterprise sales cycles with minimum six-figure ASPs
  • A record of leading lean teams of 5–15. You multiply output rather than ask for headcount
  • Hands-on use of AI that has changed how a marketing org operates, not just experiments
  • Excellent writing, verbal communication and presenting. Your bylines are compelling, your presentations are clear and your presence with executive buyers is authoritative

Preferred

  • Deep understanding of marketing data, analytics and measurement. You don't just talk about data quality; you've felt the pain of bad data
  • Strong relationships in the enterprise marketing technology ecosystem: with analysts, trade press, marketing technology vendors, and industry organizations

What Sets This Apart

  • You will be defining a category, not competing in a commodity market. The narrative opportunity is significant
  • You will have genuine executive access and influence - not a seat at a table two levels below where decisions are made
  • Your buyer is one of the most respected roles in business: the enterprise CMO. You will build relationships with and be credible to the best marketing minds in the world
  • Claravine’s product actually works. Customers renew. The case studies are real. You will not be building marketing fiction on top of a weak product.

At Claravine, base salary is one part of our competitive total compensation, equity and benefits package and is determined using a salary range. The base salary range for this role is SVP $200,000-$240,000.

Salary: $200,000-$240,000

The Opportunity

The Regional Director of Revenue Management (RDRM) will serve as the strategic business partner and leader for revenue optimization across a defined geographic region within the Hyatt Inclusive Collection. This role is responsible for driving topline revenue performance through effective pricing, inventory management, and distribution strategies. The RDRM will collaborate closely with the RVP of Sales, providing strategic guidance and leadership to on-property revenue teams, ensuring alignment with Hyatt’s commercial strategy and organizational goals. You will be part of a team that is passionate about our purpose, committed to nurturing curiosity and new skills, and building connections across the organization with colleagues, customers, and guests.

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.

Why Now?

This is an exciting time to be at Hyatt. We are growing rapidly and are looking for passionate changemakers to be a part of our journey. The hospitality industry is resilient and continues to offer dynamic opportunities for upward mobility, and Hyatt is no exception.

How We Care for Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list since 2013. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer exceptional corporate benefits which include:

  • Annual allotment of free hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally

  • Flexible work schedule

  • Work-life benefits

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of our culture of care, and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect and Wellbeing. You enjoy working with others, are results driven and are looking for a variety of opportunities to develop personally and professionally.

The Role

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Partner with the RVP of Sales and other commercial leaders to create cohesive sales, marketing, and revenue strategies.

  • Lead regional revenue management practices, including pricing strategy, distribution channel optimization, inventory controls, and demand forecasting.

  • Analyze market trends, competitor performance, and demand patterns to identify opportunities and risks.

  • Drive adoption of revenue management systems, tools, and best practices across all properties in the region.

  • Provide leadership, mentorship, and coaching to on-property Directors of Revenue Management and revenue teams.

  • Monitor property and regional revenue performance against established KPIs, including RevPAR, GOPPAR, ADR, and occupancy.

  • Prepare and present regular performance reports, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Lead revenue-focused meetings and regional business reviews.

  • Collaborate with property General Managers, Sales & Marketing leaders, and Finance partners to align on revenue goals and initiatives.

  • Work cross-functionally with Hyatt’s corporate revenue and commercial strategy teams to ensure consistency and best practice adoption.

  • Special initiatives and cross-functional projects.

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in hotel revenue management, with at least 3 years in a multi-property or regional leadership role.

Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration

  • Certified Revenue Management Executive (CRME) through Hospitality Sales and Marketing Association (HSMAI)

  • Excel, Revenue Management System (RMS) Experience, general Distribution systems knowledge

The position responsibilities outlined above are in no way to be construed as all encompassing. Other duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may be required and/or assigned as necessary.

We welcome you:

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs, only if they meet all the listed job qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We’d love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.

We value our relationships with recruitment partners and require that agencies contact us first before submitting any candidates. Hyatt will not be responsible for any fees and obligations associated with unsolicited submissions unless a formal agreement is in place.

Must Have Skills

  • Experience leading technical discovery or proof-of-concept work for complex interactions.
