raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
  • Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
  • Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
  • Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
  • Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
  • Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
  • Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
  • Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
  • Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
  • A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
  • Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
  • Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
  • Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
  • Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
  • Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
  • Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949- GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

The Opportunity

Omada Health is at a defining inflection point. As a newly public virtual care company, the organization is pursuing an ambitious long-term vision to expand its impact, reach more members, and build one of the most important growth platforms in healthcare. This is not a routine commercial leadership role. It is a high-stakes mandate requiring a leader who can deliver near-term performance while building the commercial foundation for substantially greater scale over time.

Omada Health seeks a Chief Revenue Officer who is not simply a commercial leader but a market architect—someone who can build and lead a differentiated commercial engine capable of delivering sustained growth across existing and emerging channels. This leader will drive the strategy to integrate AI into Omada’s GTM model, expand access, deepen market penetration, and position Omada for the next phase of category leadership.

This is a singular role in digital health. The CRO will sit at the intersection of commercial execution, product experience, and enterprise transformation—owning not just revenue targets, but the commercial conditions that determine whether Omada can scale its impact and performance over the long term. The premium on a new type of leader is high. This role is for someone energized by bold mandates, operational complexity, and mission-driven growth.

Strategic Imperatives

Drive Enterprise Growth

  • Own commercial execution against Omada’s long-range growth ambitions, with accountability for near-term performance and durable long-term scale.
  • Build and execute plans that support significant increases in covered lives, enrollment, revenue, and market penetration over time.
  • Anticipate execution risk early and build contingency plans that preserve momentum when market conditions, policy dynamics, or operating assumptions shift.

Create and Expand Markets Aggressively

  • Expand Omada’s presence across health plans, PBMs, employers, Medicare, government, health systems, and other strategic growth channels.
  • Independently drive payer and employer sales to consistently deliver on and exceed ambitious enrollment and revenue targets.
  • Pioneer new channels, business models, and growth pathways that can accelerate Omada’s scale and market reach.

Lead Market Access Strategy

  • Own the commercial strategy to expand access through Medicare and other strategically important channels.
  • Build payer advocacy coalitions and partner with the executives on government affairs and market access priorities that can unlock growth at scale.
  • Navigate the intersection of regulatory requirements, policy developments, and commercial execution so market access strategy remains ahead of business needs.
  • Drive government and enterprise sales through self-insured and fully insured employer segments, as well as other large-scale access pathways.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Planning, Sequencing & Investment Strategy

  • Build and own a multi-year commercial plan that maps specific capabilities, channels, and investment levers to Omada’s growth priorities.
  • Sequence commercial investments with discipline and judgment—partnering with the B2C leader to determine when to invest in direct-to-consumer efforts, brand marketing, channel partnerships, and field expansion.
  • Translate long-term growth ambitions into a living operational blueprint that identifies which capabilities, infrastructure, brand assets, and market conditions must be built in advance.
  • Manage the tension between front-loaded investment and financial sustainability, making phased bets that are measurable, defensible, and adaptable as market signals evolve.
  • Partner with the B2C leader to architect the interplay between B2B sales execution, B2C awareness, consumer marketing, digital acquisition, and channel strategy to improve conversion and enrollment over time.
  • Continuously reassess and adapt the plan as market conditions, competitive dynamics, and P&L realities evolve—this is not a static roadmap, but a dynamic operating model.

Commercial Leadership, P&L Ownership & Execution

  • Lead the entire commercial organization, including all direct and indirect reports, with full P&L ownership and budget authority over commercial investment decisions.
  • Set the agenda, identify the ways and means to achieve targets, assign accountability, allocate resources, and make final decisions on commercial resourcing.
  • Push the team to achieve and exceed ambitious growth targets while building operating discipline and predictability.
  • Set best-in-class standards with bold decision-making, always looking for ways to improve the team, the organization, and Omada’s competitive position.
  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, requiring minimal oversight given the breadth and criticality of the role.

Organizational Build-Out and Talent and Culture Strategy

  • Build the commercial organization required for Omada’s next stage of scale, recognizing that future growth will demand different capabilities, structures, and systems than today.
  • In partnership with HR, drive talent acquisition, organizational redesign, and the creation of new functions as the company scales.
  • Establish clear performance management and calibration standards that build a strong culture and attract world-class commercial talent.
  • Redesign the organization, processes, and systems as the company evolves—this is continuous transformation, not a one-time build.
  • Integrate AI throughout the commercial organization in ways that create tangible productivity gains and measurable financial impact.

Strategic Decision-Making and Risk Ownership

  • Make timely, high-quality decisions with sound judgment in a business where sequencing, speed, and quality of execution matter deeply.
  • Listen effectively to stakeholders, then make decisive calls on strategy and execution without delay.
  • Take calculated risks both big and small, demonstrating a clear instinct and drive to win and set market standards.
  • Own commercial risk management and build contingency plans for periods of heightened execution complexity.
  • Establish the commercial team’s AI strategy to drive growth and improve internal operations in measurable ways aligned to financial targets.

Clinical-Product-Commercial Integration

  • Partner deeply with Product and R&D to develop market feedback loops shape product value propositions and inform roadmap priorities based on business needs, customer requirements, and market competitiveness.
  • Drive the integration of GLP-1 support, clinical protocols, and engagement design into the commercial value proposition.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Enterprise Leadership

  • As a standing member of Executive Leadership (EL), work effectively with EL team members to define long term strategy, resources, culture, and priorities.
  • Take an enterprise-first mentality and help other executives arrive at the right choices for the company—not just advocate for the commercial organization.
  • Drive change across the commercial team and broader business to optimize processes for a growing and scaling organization.
  • Oversee systems and technology needs to enable commercial success at scale.

What Makes This CRO Different

This is not a traditional CRO role. The right candidate will be distinguished by:

  • Market creator, not just market capturer. Omada is looking for a leader who can expand demand, open new pathways to growth, and help define the next chapter of the category.
  • Commercial architect, not just commercial operator. This leader must build a sequenced, multi-year operating plan that knows which levers to pull, when to pull them, and what the P&L can sustain.
  • Ecosystem strategist, not just sales leader. Medicare expansion and broader access strategy require a leader who understands the intersection of growth, policy, and market structure.
  • Product thinker, not just commercial executor. Sustainable growth requires a CRO who understands how product, outcomes, and market value reinforce one another.
  • Organizational architect, not just team manager. The commercial engine will need to evolve significantly as Omada scales.
  • Autonomous operator, not delegated executor. This leader functions as the President’s true commercial peer, not a report waiting for direction.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Track Record

  • 15+ years of commercial leadership with demonstrated experience scaling organizations through order-of-magnitude growth, not just incremental expansion.
  • Track record in healthcare, digital health, or health services where clinical outcomes and commercial success are intertwined.
  • Proven success in payer and employer sales, including Medicare and large self-insured accounts, with experience navigating regulatory-dependent market expansion.
  • History of building commercial organizations from earlier-stage to large-scale—not just inheriting mature teams.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-year commercial transformations where early decisions materially shape long-term performance.

Leadership Profile

  • Bold, decisive leader with a bias toward action and a track record of making high-quality decisions under uncertainty.
  • Strong fit with and belief in Omada’s values.
  • Natural pioneer who has opened new channels, created new business models, and entered markets that did not previously exist.
  • Strong enterprise mindset with the ability to influence peers, drive cross-functional alignment, and put the company first.
  • Proven ability to set best-in-class standards and continuously raise the bar on organizational performance.
  • Clear instinct and drive to win, with demonstrated ability to push teams beyond what they believed possible.

Strategic, Operational & Planning Depth

  • Deep understanding of value-based care, outcomes-based contracting, and healthcare economics.
  • Experience at the intersection of commercial strategy and health policy, including government affairs or payer advocacy.
  • Demonstrated ability to build phased, multi-year commercial operating plans that sequence capability investments, channel activation, and market-shaping initiatives against financial constraints.
  • Experience orchestrating the interplay between enterprise sales and consumer marketing, understanding how brand investment and direct-to-consumer motions can lift B2B conversion and enrollment.
  • Track record of making investment timing decisions that balance aggressive growth ambitions with P&L discipline.
  • Sophisticated risk management capabilities—able to build contingency plans while executing ambitious targets.
  • Strong systems thinking with the ability to identify and implement enabling technologies and processes for a scaling organization.
  • Expertise in performance management, resource allocation, and organizational design through multiple stages of growth.

Success Metrics

Growth and Market Performance

  • Revenue, enrollment, and covered lives growth tracking ahead of plan.
  • Market access expansion contributing meaningfully to growth through Medicare, employers, health plans, and other strategic channels.
  • Consumer marketing and brand investment demonstrably improving enterprise conversion and enrollment performance over time.
  • Commercial plans and investment milestones clearly linked to sustainable P&L performance.

Commercial Organization Health

  • World-class commercial team built and scaled through successive phases of growth.
  • Performance management and culture that attract and retain top talent that reflect Omada’s values.
  • Cross-functional partnership effectiveness with Product, R&D, Executive Leadership, and the B2C leader.
  • Quality and timeliness of strategic decision-making across all commercial domains.

This role is an opportunity to lead the commercial strategy behind one of the most ambitious growth stories in digital health. The mandate is bold: expand access, accelerate growth, and build a commercial organization that can scale Omada’s impact over time.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Ireland | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
  • Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
  • Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
  • Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
  • Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
  • Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
  • Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
  • Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
  • Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
  • A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
  • Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
  • Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
  • Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
  • Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
  • Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
  • Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Ireland, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 133,600- EUR 160,320. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.description:
Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

About the role:

We love our customers and always aim to provide the best service. If you like working at home, this job is for you!

INFO: The Schedule for the shift is 11:00 am- 20:00 pm (5 days/week) with 1 hour of break.

You will be expected to:

  • Customer Service by e-mail, phone or social media for solving any incidents generated
  • Managing incoming calls and chats and customer service inquiries
  • Provide accurate, valid and complete information by using the right methods/tools
  • Handle customer complaints, provide appropriate solutions and alternatives within the time limits; follow up to ensure resolution. Keep records of customer interactions, process customer accounts, and file documents
  • Follow communication procedures, guidelines, and policies
  • Take the extra mile to engage customers
  • As the resolutions of incidents are not constant, parallel work for the Department of Operations will be performed.

About you:

  • Previous experience in User Support or Customer Service positions are highly valuable.
  • Previous experience using Zendesk is preferred.
  • High German level (oral & written) and fluent in English, Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Skilled at planning, organizing, prioritizing and executing simultaneous tasks.
  • Have good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Are a solution-oriented and reliable professional.
  • Are incredibly detail-orientated with excellent time-management skills.
  • Are flexible. Everything can change very quickly and you know how to adapt
  • Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Be decisive and organized.
  • Love being part of a dynamic team in a growing company.
  • Candidates must reside in Brazil

You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn, and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

This role is located in Brazil.

Benefits & Perks

  • Home office
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!
  • Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Health Insurance
  • Gympass Membership

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.

If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice

raw.description:
Location: Remote, within 6 hours of US Eastern Time

About SPUN

SPUN (Society for the Protection of Underground Networks) is a startup NGO with a mission to map and protect the mycorrhizal fungal networks that regulate Earth’s climate and ecosystems. These fungi draw down approximately 13 billion tons of CO2 each year, yet they have been largely overlooked by science, policy, and practice.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve built a global data platform to make these invisible networks measurable. Through our Underground Explorers program and network of over 700 Science Associates across more than 80 countries, with the majority in the Global South, we generate high-resolution biodiversity maps and ML-powered tools that integrate mycorrhizal data into climate, conservation, restoration, and land management decisions.

Our work spans laboratory research, data science, and robotics through to locally led field applications, and we’ve begun working with policymakers and restoration practitioners to apply our findings on the ground. With strong backing from leading foundations and growing momentum in international policy circles, we’re now at an inflection point: scaling these efforts across more landscapes, institutions, and countries over the long term.

That next phase calls for new capabilities. We’re strengthening our data science and impact strategy capabilities alongside our research, and have recently brought in leaders in global policy and impact, partnerships and adoption, and restoration science. Over the next two to three years, we expect to add people at every level, from directors to managers and coordinators. Doing this efficiently, across new disciplines and with a team spread across many countries, is a real organizational challenge.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Head of People & Organizational Development to shape how SPUN works as it grows. This is not a traditional HR role. Day-to-day HR administration will sit with a dedicated Operations Manager. Your focus is the organization itself: how our people collaborate, make decisions, develop, and use the tools available to them to do their best work.

You will work closely with senior leadership across three connected areas:

Ways of working. Design the structures, rhythms, and practices that keep a distributed, multidisciplinary team aligned and moving quickly. That covers how decisions get made and how knowledge gets shared. It also covers how scientists, data scientists, policy specialists, and partnership leads work together toward shared goals.

Tools and technology. Shape the tools we rely on so they actually serve the work. This includes AI, which we believe can help expand what a small, distributed organization can accomplish in research, operations, and partnerships, but caution is also needed. The goal is not simply rolling out new tools—it is building the skills, judgment, and confidence to use them well without compromising scientific integrity.

Culture and leadership. Help our culture scale as new teams and leaders join. That means developing managers, building feedback and growth practices, and making sure people from very different disciplines and places feel part of one organization.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Design & Growth

  • Design and evolve SPUN’s organizational structure as we grow, so that teams, roles, reporting lines, and leadership responsibilities support our strategy.
  • Partner with senior leadership to anticipate the capabilities SPUN will need as we expand into new disciplines, and shape a thoughtful approach to hiring across levels.
  • Assess organizational health regularly, using clear indicators to identify where structure, capacity, or ways of working are creating friction or limiting impact.
  • Work with the Operations Manager to ensure people policies and processes reflect SPUN’s values and work well across the countries where we operate.

Ways of Working

  • Design the operating rhythms, decision-making processes, and planning practices that keep a distributed team aligned and moving quickly.
  • Strengthen how knowledge is captured and shared across the organization, so that work doesn’t depend on a single person, meeting, or time zone.
  • Improve how scientists, data scientists, policy specialists, and partnership leads collaborate toward shared goals, including the handoffs between research and applied work.

Tools & AI Adoption

  • Shape SPUN’s core tools and how we use them, making sure they benefit the research, our people, the organization, and our interactions with partners and the public.
  • Partner with senior leadership to develop SPUN’s approach to AI. Identify where it can meaningfully increase our impact and capacity, while weighing the implications for our mission and people.
  • Work with team leads to identify high-value AI use cases and the workflows, roles, and skills needed to make the most of them.
  • Build AI fluency across the organization through training, peer learning, experimentation, and practical resources tailored to different roles and levels of technical expertise.
  • Create ways for teams to share experiments, emerging practices, and lessons learned, so that adoption becomes a collective capability rather than a collection of individual efforts.

Culture & Connection

  • Create the conditions for a healthy, ambitious, and inclusive culture across a globally distributed organization, including practical approaches to team health, feedback, conflict resolution, and trust-building.
  • Build intentional opportunities for connection across time zones, disciplines, and teams, recognizing that many colleagues rarely work together in person.
  • Design and facilitate retreats, team sessions, and leadership gatherings that strengthen relationships and improve how we work together.
  • Design onboarding that brings new team members into SPUN’s culture and ways of working, not just its systems.
  • Develop a thoughtful approach to recognizing team and individual achievements.

Leadership, Performance & Development

  • Partner with senior leaders and managers to strengthen their ability to lead people as SPUN grows, with clear expectations for management and leadership.
  • Establish effective practices for feedback, goal-setting, development conversations, and performance reviews, so people understand what success looks like in their roles and how they can grow.
  • Develop progression pathways, including support for people moving from individual contributor roles into management.
  • Identify opportunities for learning and professional development across the organization.

Required Qualifications

Organizational builder. You have 7+ years of experience helping organizations scale and build culture, trust, connection, and accountability, ideally where people work remotely across time zones.

Strategist who builds. You can shape the strategy and then roll up your sleeves to build the processes, frameworks, and systems yourself.

Deeply curious about people. You want to understand what motivates people, how teams function, and what gets in the way of people doing their best work. You listen carefully and get to the real problem quickly.

Trusted leadership partner. You are comfortable advising senior leaders and challenging their thinking when necessary, while building strong relationships and credibility. You handle sensitive information and complex interpersonal situations with maturity and care.

Experienced in changing how people work. You have led the adoption of new tools, technologies, or ways of working, including AI. You know that lasting change depends on training, change management, and building confidence, not just rollout.

Excellent communicator. You communicate equally well with scientists, data scientists, policy and partnership specialists, and senior leadership, adapting your approach to different audiences.

Mission-driven. You are excited by SPUN’s mission and motivated to build the organizational conditions that allow a pioneering environmental NGO to have greater impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a science, research, environmental, or impact-driven organization.
  • Experience in a globally distributed organization operating across multiple countries and employment jurisdictions.
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary teams that span science, policy, partnerships, and operations.
  • Experience building career frameworks, performance systems, or development programs from scratch.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and a genuine interest in how they will change the way organizations work.

Why Join SPUN

At SPUN, we know that taking care of our team means empowering people to do their best work. Our benefits support health, well-being, growth, and balance. They are tailored to local laws so that everyone across our globally distributed team receives the same high standard of support.

We believe work should be both impactful and sustainable, and our benefits are designed to help you thrive in your role and beyond.

At SPUN, we embrace diversity as a fundamental pillar of our mission to protect underground ecosystems. Our commitment to decolonizing science depends on the diversity of knowledge and experience on our team and among our partners across the globe. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or background, feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. We highly encourage individuals from traditionally underrepresented or marginalized groups, including but not limited to women, LGBTQIA+ people, individuals from the Global South, and individuals with Indigenous heritage, to apply to join our team at SPUN.

To learn more about our organization and culture, please visit our website .

Please apply directly on our Career Page. Please not reach out to the hiring manager directly to ensure an equitable process for all candidates.

raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
  • Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
  • Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
  • Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
  • Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
  • Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
  • Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
  • Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
  • Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
  • A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
  • Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
  • Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
  • Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
  • Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
  • Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
  • Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 996,819- SEK 1,196,182. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.description:
• Develop and maintain core positioning, messaging frameworks, and value propositions for Mirantis’ AI infrastructure and cloud-native platform portfolio.

  • Translate highly technical product capabilities — GPU cluster orchestration, multi-cluster Kubernetes management, MLOps pipelines — into audience-specific narratives for practitioners, platform engineers, and C-suite buyers.

  • Own the competitive intelligence function: track competitors including Red Hat OpenShift AI, NVIDIA Base Command, Rancher/SUSE, VMware Tanzu, and emerging AI cloud providers; produce battlecards, comparisons, and win/loss analysis.

  • Produce a steady cadence of high-quality technical content: solution briefs, white papers, blog posts, use case studies, reference architectures, and demo scripts.

  • Partner with solution architects and product managers to develop technical content that educates buyers on AI infrastructure patterns, including LLM inference at scale, GPU scheduling, and developer platform self-service.

  • Support demand generation campaigns with compelling assets aligned to key personas: AI/ML engineers, platform ops teams, and infrastructure decision-makers.

  • Build and maintain sales enablement materials, including pitch decks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and ROI frameworks.

  • Partner with solution architects and sales teams to distill field learnings into sharper messaging and better-targeted content.

  • Support product launches with go-to-market plans, launch kits, and internal training materials.

  • Monitor trends across the AI infrastructure, cloud-native, and open-source ecosystems to surface market insights that inform GTM strategy.

  • Support analyst and media briefings; contribute to Mirantis’ positioning in key industry conversations and reports.

  • Represent Mirantis’ platform perspective at industry events, webinars, and community forums as a subject matter resource.

Required Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of experience in product marketing, technical marketing, or a closely adjacent role (solutions marketing, developer marketing, content strategy) within the cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or enterprise software space.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and credibly communicate complex technical concepts related to:

    • Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud-native platforms

    • AI/ML infrastructure, including model serving, inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling

    • Hybrid and multi-cloud deployment patterns across AWS, GCP, and Azure

  • Strong writing and storytelling skills — able to produce clear, engaging content for both technical and business audiences without heavy editing.

  • Experience developing sales enablement materials and working directly with sales and pre-sales teams.

  • Familiarity with the competitive landscape across cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, and open-source ecosystems (e.g., Red Hat, NVIDIA, Canonical, Rancher/SUSE, HashiCorp).

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy.

Soft Skills and Team Fit

  • Intellectually curious with a genuine interest in how AI infrastructure works under the hood.

  • Strong cross-functional collaborator — comfortable engaging with engineers, product managers, and executives alike.

  • Structured thinker who can manage multiple projects and deadlines without losing narrative coherence.

  • Passion for open source, developer communities, and the cloud-native ecosystem.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward shipping content and iterating quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, MLflow, Kubeflow, Ray, or similar infrastructure tooling.

  • Background in or exposure to AI/ML engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering.

  • Prior experience in or familiarity with companies like RunPod, SpectroCloud, Rafay, Anyscale, Hugging Face, Together AI, or Modal.

  • Experience supporting analyst relations or contributing to industry research and reports.

  • CNCF ecosystem knowledge or cloud/Kubernetes certifications a plus.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry.

  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.

  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.

  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.

  • Receive a competitive compensation package with strong benefits plan

#remote

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

title: KYC产品经理
description: • 这个职位为何存在？它解决什么问题？我们为什么现在需要它？ KYC 是用户准入的第一道门，直接影响转化率、欺诈与合规成本。该岗位存在的意义是：把「能过审」变成「又好又快又准」的产品体验，用指标体系定位链路断点，并用竞品与技术扫描保持方案不过时。现在需要它，是因为业务增长与审核精度、自动规则、法规解读之间需要专人持续做产品化平衡，而不是靠运营或风控临时补位。 • 核心职责（3-5条） • 主导 KYC 产品功能设计与体验优化，提升流程转化率与核验准确性。 • 搭建并维护 KYC 数据指标体系，定期采集与分析使用数据，识别并推动解决转化链路中的关键痛点。 • 持续跟踪行业与竞品动态，结构化输出竞品能力、差异点与市场策略，反哺产品路线与优先级。 • 研究并评估新兴 KYC 技术（如 AI 身份识别、区块链数据共享等），判断其适用场景、风险边界与对现有产品的价值，形成可落地的引入或试点建议。 • 理想候选人是什么样的？ 熟悉 KYC 全链路语言——从用户填表、证件采集、活体/OCR 到自动审核与人工兜底——并能用数据说话：先定义「哪里漏、哪里卡、哪里误杀」，再改交互与策略。对「秒过」有工程化理解：知道在什么合规与风险边界下追求极致体验，而不是单纯追求表面通过率。习惯主动扫厂商能力与行业方案，比较优劣后能写清楚「我们为什么选 A 不选 B」。能把法规要求读进产品规格里，而不是停留在合规部门的 PPT 上。 • 吸引人的亮点（1-2条） 2.

• 这个职位为何存在？它解决什么问题？我们为什么现在需要它？
KYC 是用户准入的第一道门，直接影响转化率、欺诈与合规成本。该岗位存在的意义是：把「能过审」变成「又好又快又准」的产品体验，用指标体系定位链路断点，并用竞品与技术扫描保持方案不过时。现在需要它，是因为业务增长与审核精度、自动规则、法规解读之间需要专人持续做产品化平衡，而不是靠运营或风控临时补位。
  • 核心职责（3-5条）
    • 主导 KYC 产品功能设计与体验优化，提升流程转化率与核验准确性。
    • 搭建并维护 KYC 数据指标体系，定期采集与分析使用数据，识别并推动解决转化链路中的关键痛点。
    • 持续跟踪行业与竞品动态，结构化输出竞品能力、差异点与市场策略，反哺产品路线与优先级。
    • 研究并评估新兴 KYC 技术（如 AI 身份识别、区块链数据共享等），判断其适用场景、风险边界与对现有产品的价值，形成可落地的引入或试点建议。
  • 理想候选人是什么样的？
    • 熟悉 KYC 全链路语言——从用户填表、证件采集、活体/OCR 到自动审核与人工兜底——并能用数据说话：先定义「哪里漏、哪里卡、哪里误杀」，再改交互与策略。对「秒过」有工程化理解：知道在什么合规与风险边界下追求极致体验，而不是单纯追求表面通过率。习惯主动扫厂商能力与行业方案，比较优劣后能写清楚「我们为什么选 A 不选 B」。能把法规要求读进产品规格里，而不是停留在合规部门的 PPT 上。
    • 吸引人的亮点（1-2条）
    1. 工作直接挂钩 转化率与准确性 等可感知业务结果，改动能快速在数据上验证。
    2. 可深度接触 AI 身份识别、OCR、自动审核与风控规则 的交叉地带，并参与前沿技术方案的评估与落地路径设计。

raw.title: Smart Contract Engineer
raw.excerpt: About:Veda is the DeFi engine powering financial apps enabling platforms to seamlessly create on-chain yield products.
raw.description:
About:

Veda is the DeFi engine powering financial apps enabling platforms to seamlessly create on-chain yield products. Our mission is to unlock DeFi for the world by providing seamless, enterprise-grade integrations for modern finance. Veda's technology powers many of DeFi's largest vault products, including Liquid, PlasmaUSD Vault, Lombard DeFi Vault, and Mantle cmETH.
At $6B in TVL and 100k+ users, Veda is one of the fastest growing DeFi protocols with a team passionate about DeFi and dedicated to our work. This role will be high impact and have the opportunity to directly shape some of the most critical infrastructure in DeFi.

Role:

As a Smart Contract Engineer, you will contribute to our Solidity engineering organization — architecture, delivery, and security for all on-chain code. You will help to uphold world-class security and reliability standards for contracts securing ten-figure TVL.
We seek individuals with high agency to join us in defining the next phase of DeFi growth and adoption. The ideal candidate takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and adapts swiftly to evolving demands.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to all Solidity codebases, including upgrade patterns, proxy architecture, account abstraction, and cross-chain messaging.
  • Drive rigorous design reviews, threat modeling, fuzz testing, and formal verification to achieve “audit-by-design” security
  • Continuous deployment, maintenance, and upgrades of existing vaults
  • Own end-to-end delivery of new protocol features
  • Manage external auditors and bug-bounty programs; implement on-chain monitoring and incident-response playbooks
  • Represent Veda in client integrations, conferences, and the broader open-source community

What you'll bring:

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience
  • 2-3+ years writing production Solidity (ERC-20/4626, custom libraries, proxy & upgrade patterns)
  • Track record of creating or maintaining a contract suite without critical incidents
  • Knowledge of EVM internals, gas optimization, storage layout, and common smart-contract exploits (re-entrancy, oracle manipulation, MEV)
  • Fluency with Foundry and/or Hardhat,
  • Excellent written and verbal English; comfortable presenting to executives, auditors, and the wider community

Preferred Skills & Experience:

  • Familiarity with multi-chain DeFi interactions and cross-chain messaging standards
  • Professional experience using Rust
  • Experience using Move-based smart-contract platforms (Aptos) would be a huge plus also.
  • Background in traditional finance, risk, credit, or derivatives a plus
  • Active contributor to open-source security research, EIPs, or protocol governance
  • Formal-verification expertise
  • Experience with audit cycles with top-tier firms (e.g., Trail of Bits, Spearbit)

Benefits at Veda

We’re a small, tight-knit team building the infrastructure that powers a new generation of financial products - on-chain, composable, and accessible to anyone. We believe the full potential of DeFi is still ahead of us, and we’re here to help unlock it.
We also believe that great work comes from people who feel trusted, supported, and aligned with the mission. Here’s how we try to make that happen:

Health Coverage

We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees. For international contractors, we work closely to ensure access to appropriate local or global health coverage.

Flexible Time Off

We don’t track vacation days. Take the time you need to rest and recharge—we trust you to manage your schedule.

Remote-First by Design

Our team spans time zones and geographies. We work async, with a focus on autonomy over micromanagement.

Parental Leave

Paid leave is available for new parents, whether you’re the primary or secondary caregiver.

Learning & Development

We offer stipends to support ongoing learning - whether it’s a course, a conference, or something else that helps you grow.

Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.
Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.
We’re looking for experienced Certified Shorthand Reporters to partner with Filevine as an independent certified court reporting professional through our deposition services network.
This is an exciting opportunity to work with a court-reporter-first company that’s redefining the deposition experience, while making sure reporters are supported and respected. As part of our network, you’ll get access to a robust nationwide marketplace of job opportunities and white-glove operational support that help you focus on delivering exceptional transcripts — not hassling with logistics.

Responsibilities

  • Capture and deliver high-quality, verbatim transcripts of depositions and other legal proceedings
  • Use CAT software to scope, proofread, and finalize certified transcripts to the highest standards.
  • Manage proceedings with professionalism, ensuring punctuality, accuracy, decorum, and adherence to procedural rules in your jurisdiction.
  • Mark and manage exhibits.
  • Collaborate with our operations team as needed for scheduling, setup, and technical coordination.
  • Submit completed transcript files within appropriate turnaround time and invoices for prompt payment.

Qualifications

  • Current Iowa Certified Shorthand Reporter certificate (CSR) from the Iowa Judicial Branch/Office of Professional Regulation required
  • Proven ability to deliver accurate transcripts on deadline.
  • Expertise with CAT software (e.g., Case CATalyst, Eclipse, etc.) and related digital tools.
  • Professionalism, confidentiality, and a client-service mindset when working with attorneys, witnesses, and clients.
  • Strong communication skills and adaptability in fast-paced, high-stakes settings.

Why Work With Us?

Unmatched support — tech setup assistance, live troubleshooting, and a responsive operations team to provide support with any questions or concerns you might have.
Access to a nationwide job marketplace — with the flexibility to choose assignments that fit your schedule.
Innovation at your fingertips — modern online portal to streamline your work.
Competitive rates —offer competitive page rates, appearance fees, and additional fees in your market area.
Flexibility - offer remote and in-person to accommodate your schedule.
Fast payment — we complete your payment within 5 business days of invoice approval.

岗位职责：

区块核心模块设计与开发

系统维护及性能优化

跟进行业技术发展动态，并进行落地应用

任职要求

1.计算机相关专业，本科及以上学历，至少5年以上开发经验，拥有区块链底层开发经验。

2.编程语言：精通Go，Rust(必选项）

3.操作系统与网络：熟悉 Linux 系统编程、进程线程、网络 IO；掌握 P2P 网络协议（libp2p、Kademlia）、Gossip 传播机制，能实现高并发网络服务。

4.共识机制：理解 PoW、PoS、PBFT、HotStuff 等，掌握拜占庭容错与一致性原理。

5.公连知识：熟悉CosmosSDK相关原理和代码。加分项：熟悉公连的相关原理与代码。

6.密码学：精通Keccak，（ECDSA、EdDSA、BLS），（secp256k1）；（zkSNARK、zkSTARK)。

7.数据结构与存储：区块与交易结构，Merkle Tree、Patricia Trie、Verkle Tree；掌握 LevelDB/RocksDB 用于状态存储、快照与裁剪。

8.虚拟机与执行环境：理解 EVM 工作原理、Gas 模型及安全性；加分项：了解SVM和WASM。

9.工程与工具：熟悉 Docker/K8s 部署测试网络，掌握 CI/CD 与性能调优工具（perf、pprof）。

10.进阶方向：Layer2（Rollup、状态通道）、跨链协议（IBC、XCMP）、数据可用性（Celestia）、隐私技术（ZKP 电路设计）。

11. 加分项：精通SubStrate框架

raw.title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
raw.excerpt: About Smart WorkingAt Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day.
raw.description:
About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening.

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality.

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

Responsibilities

  • Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on.
  • Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives.
  • Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date.
  • Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin.
  • Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Drive the UI through a page object model.
  • Add data-test-ids to React code where missing.
  • Validate correct database state using SQL.
  • Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive.
  • Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned.
  • Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications.
  • Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly.
  • Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation.
  • Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases.
  • Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline.
  • Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin.
  • 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright.
  • 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests.
  • 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication.
  • 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction.
  • Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction.
  • Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications.
  • Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient.

Nice to Have

  • Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps.
  • Experience with Appium or Flutter integration_test.
  • Experience reading and working with React front-end code.
  • Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework.
  • Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC.
  • Experience in another regulated or audited environment.
  • ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing.
  • Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC.
  • Healthtech or digital health domain experience.
  • Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow.

Benefits

  • Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  • No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  • Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  • Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  • True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

title: 内容风控专家
description: 这个职位为何存在？ 随着平台全景化业务的快速扩张，多语言文本、图片等场景下的欺诈引流、黑灰、产对抗形式日益严峻。该职位旨在建立一道坚固的交易所社交内容安全防线。 解决什么问题： 解决多语种多产品线生态下，传统风控手段对复杂欺诈变体、多模态（图文结合）违规行为（特别是引流）识别率低、对抗滞后的问题。补全目前风控团队缺失的内容风控能力板块，赋能交易所核心业务。 为什么现在需要它： 目前不法用户通过平台提供的社交功能大肆散播引流、欺诈图文，已经严重负面影响到C2C、代理、增长等核心业务，且风控团队内部暂时缺少内容风控领域人才和技术储备，急需有内容对抗经验的专家进来建设体系化的内容治理能力。 核心职责（3-5条） 1、构建全球多语言、多场景下的内容安全策略矩阵，针对欺诈、引流等违规行为搭建事前防御、事中监控、事后治理的全链路体系。 2、主导黑词库、黑图库等风控基础设施建设，推进文本与图片融合的多模态内容安全识别体系落地。 3、驱动多语言NLP模型及多模态融合模型的应用与高频迭代，深度联动算法团队，将前沿AI/Agent技术转化为实际的风控生产力。 4、建立可量化的内容安全效果评估体系，对风控核心指标进行深度拆解与数据漏斗分析，确保策略的精准度与召回率。 理想候选人是什么样的？ 1、具备敏锐的嗅觉与死磕到底的对抗精神： 对海内外社交生态中的违规变体有天然的警惕性，享受与黑灰、产博弈的过程，能从微弱的异常数据中揪出系统性风险。 2、拥有自驱型的“破局者”思维： 不满足于现成规则，面对小语种对抗等模糊、复杂的场景，能够主动拥抱AI Agent等新工具，自发寻找技术边界来拆解难题。 3、具备出色的跨界协同力： 既懂业务策略又能与研发“讲同一种语言”，能平衡风控效果与业务打扰 吸引人的亮点 1、真正的全景化视野与前沿AI实战场景： 你将直接操盘头部交易所的核心安全命脉，亲手将经典内容风控体系、AI Agent及多模态大模型推向千万级用户的实战对抗一线，并带来可量化的业务价值，而非做单纯的规则修补。 2、从0到1构建内容风控体系的绝对主导权： 团队氛围自驱且技术自豪感，你将主导多模态体系与核心库的搭建，你的每一个策略都将直接定义产品的安全边界。开放的行业/背景国际化互联网平台（出海社交/Live/社区）、跨境电商、交易所、反欺诈/内容安全服务商。
